Intrinsic evaluation covers four properties verifiable by construction -- ontological atomicity, dimensional equivalence, typographic robustness, and numerical reconstruction -- over an internal, physically validated benchmark (EngQuant, N=800) and four Brazilian Portuguese external corpora (N=1771 eligible cases). We also report detection recall, distinguishing coverage from conditional atomicity. Against eight state-of-the-art baselines, TOTEN achieves unit ontological atomicity in all contrasts and numerical reconstruction of 0.775-0.904 on external corpora, vs. 0.627-0.703 for the best baseline (Quantulum3); on EngQuant, 0.780 vs. 0.340. Differences are statistically significant (McNemar with Holm correction). Spearman correlation between internal and external rankings confirms concurrent validity of the control benchmark. Dimensional equivalence shows statistical parity with Pint, the oracle from which the system inherits dimensional authority.

</details>


### [266] [AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19630)
*H. Sinan Bank,Daniel R. Herber,Thomas Bradley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对2020—2025年AI与系统工程（SE）交叉领域进行了系统综述，将发展划分为基础、应用与LLM拐点三个阶段；通过1位人类专家与6个AI模型对1,712篇INCOSE INSIGHT文章与889篇SERC出版物进行人机一致性文献评审，识别出五个关键研究缺口，并提供面向实践者的采纳指南与开源交互式Web工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估AI4SE/SE4AI领域的高速发展势头是否与其证据基础相匹配——即在研讨会注册人数激增、INCOSE设立专门LLM跟踪的同时，核心文献的实证基础是否足够扎实。作者旨在追溯领域共识、揭示研究缺口并为从业者提供AI采纳、保障与劳动力转型方面的可操作指引。

Method: 采用两类证据：（1）叙事性文献回顾，基于作者对核心论文的研读构建三阶段框架；（2）人机一致性文献评审，1位人类专家与6个AI模型（3个商用：Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.2；3个本地开源：Mixtral 8x22B、Llama 3.3 70B、DeepSeek R1 70B）独立判断论文相关性；INSIGHT语料仅基于标题筛选，SERC语料采用"仅标题"与"标题+摘要"两种条件对比；计算一致性百分比与Cohen's κ，并辅以Google Scholar引用数据分析。

Result: 人类专家在1,712篇INSIGHT文章中判定46篇相关，其中33篇与至少一个商用模型达成共识；商用模型与人类一致性达97.8%—99.0%（κ=0.67—0.77），本地模型差异显著（80.8%—96.7%，κ从0.10到0.71不等）；引用数据显示33篇共识文章平均引用9.5次，其余为2.4次；提出三阶段框架（基础2020—2021、应用2022—2023、LLM拐点2024—2025），识别五大缺口（实证验证不足、SE与软件工程混淆、缺乏SE专用基准、AI生成制品的可追溯性、劳动力转型）；共识集中于"增强智能"范式与AI4SE/SE4AI二元性。

Conclusion: AI与SE交叉领域已从概念路线图发展为快速扩张的研究与实践领域，增强智能范式与AI4SE/SE4AI双重性已成为社区共识；但在工业级实证验证、领域专用基准、可追溯性框架与劳动力转型方面仍存在重大缺口；商用模型在该任务上表现中等至较强可靠性，开源本地模型表现极不稳定；建议实践者优先投资于人机协同设计模式与AI生成制品的可追溯性基础设施，以证据而非热情为决策依据。

Abstract: The March 2020 INCOSE INSIGHT special issue on AI and Systems Engineering (SE) became the most downloaded issue in the publication's history and launched a research community that now draws over 250 registrants to its annual workshop. In this article, we trace the progress in AI and SE across three phases (labeled here foundational, applied, and LLM inflection) based on the authors' reading of the field's core papers, and describe our opinions of where the community has converged and where critical gaps remain. Separately, a human-AI agreement literature review leveraging both human expertise and six AI models was performed to assess the relevance of 1,712 INCOSE INSIGHT articles and 889 SERC publications. The results identify five critical research gaps and offer guidance for practitioners navigating AI adoption, assurance, and workforce transformation in SE. We share the agreement data and the AI4SE/SE4AI Explorer web application so readers can compare their own relevance judgments with the human and AI raters.

</details>


### [267] [BrainG3N: A Dual-Purpose Tokenizer for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19651)
*Max Van Puyvelde,Ibrahim Gulluk,Wim Van Criekinge,Olivier Gevaert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BrainG3N提出了一种双用途3D脑MRI分词器，将冻结的3D MAE编码器与专用CNN解码器解耦，通过线性投影连接。编码器在18个公开队列的35,309个脑MRI体积上预训练，产生临床信息丰富的嵌入空间。该嵌入空间在23项线性探针任务中优于或匹配BrainIAC、BrainSegFounder和MedicalNet等SOTA模型（21/23任务），同时支持基于条件DiT的六变量可控生成和患者特异性纵向预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D放射学潜在扩散管道使用单一编码器-解码器针对重建目标训练，使编码器偏向体素保真度而牺牲临床内容，导致潜在空间通常仅基于体素级重建指标评估，难以同时支持临床下游任务和可控生成。

Method: 两阶段分词器设计：（1）阶段一在35,309个脑MRI体积上预训练3D MAE编码器（12层ViT，隐藏维度1152，16³块，70%掩码率），强制编码器从360个可见块重建840个掩码块以建模长程解剖上下文；（2）阶段二冻结编码器，通过线性投影P∈ℝ^1152×32将1200个token压缩至32通道，再用3D CNN解码器以ℓ1损失重建体素。条件流匹配DiT（12块，隐藏维度1152，18头）以adaLN-Zero调制接受6个条件（疾病8路、性别、模态4路、采集点19路、年龄连续、IDH1二元），配以分类器自由引导（s=2.0）；纵向变体使用消失端点布朗桥（σ=0.5）在ADNI T1基线-随访对（约25k）上训练。

Result: （1）架构验证：在1100体积肿瘤队列上，MAE+CNN在d'=32下IDH1 AUC 0.861，超过匹配计算量的AKL基线（0.801）。（2）线性探针：在23项任务中21/23优于或匹配BrainIAC、BSF、MedicalNet，IDH1 AUC 0.937、肿瘤分级AUC 0.921、脑龄MAE 4.43年、性别AUC 0.967。（3）可控生成：DiT在6个变量上cond-null间隙清晰，疾病HC-vs-AD一致性0.99，性别0.93，年龄皮尔逊r=0.93，IDH1 0.52；3D-FID池化34.4（gen-vs-recons）/107.3（gen-vs-real），无训练集记忆。（4）纵向预测：桥采样器恢复约27%真实老化幅度（斜率0.268，皮尔逊r=0.716），解剖变化正确定位于脑室和沟回。

Conclusion: 单一3D脑MRI嵌入空间可同时服务下游临床任务和可控生成，MAE编码器解耦于CNN解码器的双阶段分词器设计在临床信息保留和体素保真之间取得更好平衡；条件DiT在六变量可控生成和患者特异性纵向预测上验证了嵌入空间的生成可控性，潜在扩散中的探针-可控性传递连接了临床表型编码与生成分可控性。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) brain MRI is central to clinical neurology and neuro-oncology, where generative models could augment under-represented cohorts, simulate disease trajectories, and support privacy-preserving data sharing. Latent diffusion has been the go-to solution for modeling imaging data, but it places two competing demands on the tokenizer: encoder embeddings must retain the clinical information that downstream tasks act on, and the decoder must reconstruct anatomically faithful volumes. Existing reconstruction-driven tokenizers achieve the second at the expense of the first. To address this, we introduce a fully volumetric masked-autoencoder (MAE) based tokenizer for 3D brain MRI latent diffusion, decoupling encoder and decoder: a frozen 3D MAE encoder produces clinically informative embeddings, while a dedicated CNN decoder reconstructs voxels from a linear projection of those embeddings. We pretrain the encoder on 35,309 volumes from 18 public cohorts spanning four modalities, ten disease categories, and 200+ acquisition sites, and demonstrate its dual utility in two settings. First, on a 23-task linear-probing benchmark, the encoder outperforms or matches SOTA models (i.e., BrainIAC, BrainSegFounder, and MedicalNet) on 21 of 23 tasks. Second, a conditional diffusion transformer (DiT) trained on these clinically informative embeddings supports both conditional generation across six variables and patient-specific longitudinal forecasting. Together these results establish a single 3D brain-MRI embedding space capable of both downstream clinical tasks and controllable generation.

</details>


### [268] [Denoising Implicit Feedback for Cold-start Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19658)
*Gaode Chen,Shicheng Wang,Shikun Li,Rui Huang,Xinghua Zhang,Yunze Luo,Shipeng Li,Shiming Ge,Ruina Sun,Yinjie Jiang,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为DIF的模型无关去噪方法，专门解决冷启动推荐中隐式反馈噪声问题。通过利用内容相似的暖物品（warm items）的协同表示为冷物品（cold items）生成伪标签，并结合置信度建模与不确定性估计自适应地修正噪声标签。该方法已在快手（Kuaishou）亿级短视频平台成功部署并显著提升商业指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 隐式反馈（点击、观看）广泛用于推荐系统，但天然包含噪声（标题党、位置偏差等）。2. 作者发现冷启动物品因标题党（top 10%比bottom 10%多37.7%）和位置偏差（尾部位置占比高28.3%）等因素，更易产生假阳性/假阴性噪声样本，但现有去噪方法通常被忽视。3. 现有基于启发式模式（高损失值、低预测分数等）的去噪方法对冷启动场景无效，因为冷启动物品本身就具有高损失、低分数等"天然噪声"特征，且难以集成到工业流式训练中。

Method: DIF是一个三阶段的模型无关去噪框架：（1）**伪标签生成**：通过多模态推理服务和物品-物品ANN检索服务，为每个冷物品找到内容相似的top-k暖物品，利用其已训练良好的协同表示与用户兴趣表示计算内积得到k个伪标签。（2）**置信度建模**：基于内容相似度通过温度系数softmax归一化为权重，加权聚合多个伪标签得到最终伪标签 y^p。（3）**不确定性估计**：通过相对熵 r（衡量标签与预测的偏离程度）与冷启动状态 γ（基于交互次数的指数衰减）相乘得到 t = r·γ，并将权重归一化为 w = t/(t+1)。（4）**标签修正**：得到软标签 y^c = w·y^p + (1-w)·ỹ，代入交叉熵损失训练。理论证明：当暖物品数量足够大时，伪标签误差可被有效控制（Theorem 2.1），且权重方案与MSE最优解一致（Theorem 2.2）。

Result: 在三个真实多模态数据集（Amazon-Sports、Amazon-Baby、TikTok）和三种骨干网络（NeuMF、LightGCN、SimGCL）上的实验表明，DIF在冷物品的Recall@20和NDCG@20上均显著优于DECL、RINCE、MWUF等基线方法。例如在LightGCN+TikTok上，冷物品Recall@20从0.00106提升至0.00518。在20%-80%不同噪声比例下DIF均保持鲁棒性。消融实验显示冷启动状态（CS）组件贡献最大。在快手平台的在线A/B测试（2025年1月12-16日）中，有效观看+2.327%、观看时长+2.921%、长观看+2.688%、点赞+2.921%、评论+2.435%、关注+2.790%。

Conclusion: DIF成功解决了冷启动推荐中隐式反馈去噪这一被忽视但重要的问题，其核心创新在于利用内容相似的暖物品作为信息桥梁来推断冷物品的伪标签，并通过置信度建模和不确定性估计实现自适应标签修正。理论分析和广泛的离线实验证明了方法的有效性，而快手亿级用户的工业部署进一步验证了其在真实大规模场景中的实用价值和显著的商业增益。该方法为冷启动推荐的去噪研究提供了新的思路和实践参考。

Abstract: Implicit feedback is widely used in recommender systems due to its accessibility and generality, yet it usually presents noisy samples (e.g., clickbait, position bias). Meanwhile, recommenders inevitably face the item cold-start problem due to the continuous influx of new items. We identify that cold items are more prone to noisy samples due to the aforementioned factors, and researchers often overlook the significance of denoising implicit feedback for cold items. Previous denoising studies usually identify noisy samples based on heuristic patterns, such as higher loss values, and mitigate noise through sample selection or re-weighting. However, these methods have limited adaptability and are ineffective in cold-start scenarios. To achieve denoising implicit feedback for cold-start recommendation, we propose a model-agnostic denoising method called DIF. First, user preferences for content remain stable, which allows us to infer pseudo-labels indicating whether a user is interested in a cold item through content-similar warm items. Furthermore, to improve pseudo-label accuracy, we model the confidence of pseudo-labels based on the content similarity between the cold item and warm items, and then aggregate multiple pseudo-labels for each sample. Finally, we explicitly estimate the uncertainty of the noisy sample label by considering its relative entropy and the cold-start status of the item, which adaptively guides the role of pseudo-labels to correct the noisy labels at the sample level. DIF's superiority is supported by both theoretical justification and extensive experiments on real-world datasets. The method has been deployed on a billion-user scale short video application Kuaishou and has significantly improved various commercial metrics within cold-start scenarios.

</details>


### [269] [Exit-and-Join Dynamics for Decentralized Coalition Formation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19683)
*Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化的联盟形成动力学模型，将合作博弈中的Aumann-Dreze值与非合作的单边退出-加入决策相结合。研究将终止联盟结构刻画为无个体可改进偏离的均衡点，证明了序数/精确边际对齐条件是标量Lyapunov函数或精确势函数存在的前提，并通过数值实验验证了有限终止性、切换成本与接纳成本的敏感性，以及凸博弈中大联盟的动态可达性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联盟形成文献多采用自上而下的拆分-合并算法或集中式优化，假设全局信息与协调，掩盖了现实中联盟结构的去中心化涌现特性。本文旨在建立一种基于个体单边退出-加入决策的去中心化动力学框架，将合作博弈的联盟内收益分配与非合作博弈的个体最优反应行为统一起来，刻画组织结构（如劳动力市场、订阅平台、多智能体任务分配）内生涌现的过程。

Method: 方法体系包含五个层面：(1) 以Aumann-Dreze值定义联盟内个体收益，即每个智能体获得其所在联盟限制博弈的Shapley值；(2) 定义退出-加入动作与转移映射F_i(T,D)，并引入目的地联盟的接纳规则（要求现有成员收益不下降，可选接纳成本κ）与移动者的切换成本c_i；(3) 构造逐状态的非合作诱导博弈G(T)，证明退出-加入均衡等价于纯策略Nash均衡；(4) 引入序数边际对齐与精确边际对齐条件，证明前者使联盟总剩余V(T)成为严格Lyapunov函数，后者使诱导博弈成为精确势博弈；(5) 将动力学表示为块对角矩阵切换系统B_T^{AD} vec(v)的迭代更新，并通过成对随机博弈进行Monte Carlo数值实验。

Result: 主要理论结果包括：(1) 退出-加入均衡与诱导博弈纯策略Nash均衡的等价性（命题5.5）；(2) 凸博弈保证大联盟是退出-加入均衡（命题5.6）但凸性不保证唯一性（例5.8）；(3) 序数边际对齐条件下V(T)严格单调递增，保证有限时间终止（定理6.3、6.9）；(4) 精确边际对齐使诱导博弈成为精确势博弈（定理6.14、6.15）；(5) 凸性（效率属性）与边际对齐（动态可实施性）是逻辑独立的。数值实验在n=24–30的180个随机成对博弈上验证了零Lyapunov单调性违反：平均21.9步终止，平均剩余增益52.64；切换成本c=1.50时移动数降至2.3，接纳成本κ=0.25时终端联盟数从4.7增至8.2；凸基准v(S)=0.45C(|S|,2)从单元素初始分区出发经17步到达大联盟，剩余68.85。

Conclusion: 本文建立了联盟形成的去中心化动力学理论，严格区分了合作凸性（效率保证）与边际对齐（动态可实施性）这两个常被混淆的性质。Aumann-Dreze值的联盟局部结构使其与单边退出-加入更新自然兼容，但效率与动态可达性并不一致：凸博弈中大联盟是均衡但可能不唯一或不被动态选择，需更丰富的偏离机制（合并-分裂、联盟级偏离或再分配）保证全局效率。未来方向包括战略性接纳政策（可产生锁定或垄断效应）与部分信息下的学习动力学。

Abstract: This paper studies coalition formation as a decentralized dynamical process driven by unilateral exit-and-join decisions. Agents evaluate local moves using the Aumann-Dreze value, so payoffs are computed within the agent's current coalition rather than through a globally negotiated coalition structure. The resulting model links cooperative payoff allocation with noncooperative best-response behavior: a terminal partition is precisely a coalition structure with no admissible, individually profitable exit-and-join deviation. We establish equilibrium characterizations, identify conditions under which the dynamics admit scalar Lyapunov or exact-potential representations, and analyze how switching and acceptance costs shape local stability. Numerical experiments test finite-time stabilization, cost sensitivity, and a special convex-game benchmark.

</details>


### [270] [Beyond Static Leaderboards: Predictive Validity for the Evaluation of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19704)
*Dhaval C. Patel,Kaoutar El Maghraoui,Shuxin Lin,Yusheng Li,Tianjun Feng,Chun-Yi Tsai,Yihan Sun,Wei Alexander Xin,Akshat Bhandari,Tanisha Rathod,Aaron Fan,Sanskruti Vijay Shejwal,Tomas Pasiecznik,Sagar Chethan Kumar,Tanmay Agarwal,Rohith Kanathur,Sam Colman,Amaan Sheikh,Dev Bahl,Ann Li,Krish Veera,Alimurtaza Mustafa Merchant,Shambhawi Baswaraj Bhure,Sajal Kumar Goyla,Chengrui Li,Kirthana Natarajan,Rui Li,Thomas Ajai,Rujing Li,Vivek G. Iyer,Sanjaii Vijayakumar,Yitong Bai,Ayal Yakobe,Darief Maes,Yassine Jebbouri,Tianyang Xu,Thai Quoc On,Vera Mazeeva,Winston Li,Yuval Shemla,Yeshitha Bhuvanesh,Rushin Bhatt,Siddharth Chethan Gowda,Alisha Vinod,Caroline Cahill,Shriya Aishani Rachakonda,Yunfeng Chen,Aryaman Agrawal,Aman Upganlawar,Mao Le Jonathan Ang,Yubin Sally Go,Madhav Rajkondawar,Yang-Jung Chen,Trisha Maturi,Ananya Kapoor,Andrew Li,Shrey Arora,Mana Abbaszadeh,Shen Li,Charles Xu,Byeolah Kwon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文,主张以"预测效度"(样本内与样本外排名的相关性)替代聚合分数均值作为LLM智能体评估的排名准则。论文整合了14项针对AssetOpsBench(MCP工业智能体基准)的并行实现研究和7个先前的智能体基准,提出12层测量装置,定义了3个可证伪的OOD标准,并给出了4项面向下一代智能体基准的领域级建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体基准快速增长,但单一基准覆盖的部署相关维度不超过四到五个。聚合分数排行榜存在三大结构性问题:(1)聚合分数将正交维度折叠,排名无法迁移到分布外场景;(2)LLM-as-Judge评分具有反身性,PHMForge显示其Krippendorff α仅0.61,低于人-人水平的0.74-0.82;(3)CODS-2025中执行轨道的公开-隐藏Spearman相关性为-0.13(n=13),统计上与零无显著差异,直接实证了排名不稳定性。

Method: 综合分析:以AssetOpsBench(141场景,GitHub 1600+星,EMNLP/NeurIPS/AAAI录用)为锚点,整合14项并行实现研究(覆盖资产类别、编排、检索、推理、基础设施、评估方法六大轴线)与7个先前基准(AssetOpsBench、MCP-Bench、MCP-Universe、ARE/Gaia2、TaskBench、Exgentic、Condition Insight)。提出:(1)12层测量装置(T1-T7核心能力层+ T8-T12部署扩展层);(2)预测效度评分 PV(c) = αȲ_c - βσ_OOD - γIQR,权重在Criteria A上拟合;(3)三个可证伪的OOD标准——A(保留分层随机划分)、B(子集交叉迁移,6×6排名稳定矩阵)、C(语义等价对抗扰动,4类);(4)明确的证伪阈值(Spearman ρ<0.85、Top-3离开Top-5比例≥10%等)。

Result: 14项研究在6个扩展轴线上呈现收敛性架构敏感性:Plans-Execute的FMSR/TSFM被G5/G14/G16/G27独立定位为主导瓶颈;G7/G9/G12/G27独立量化MCP-stdio子进程开销为残余延迟底板。证据一致表明:11项研究发现(均跨多团队独立报告)的实施例中,聚合分数在质量/成本/推理/检索等轴线上隐藏了质的差异(如推理开关在清晰度维度有31pp差异但总分持平)。CODS-2025执行轨道ρ=-0.13(n=13)部分支持证伪条件1;但样本量过小,95% CI约[-0.64, +0.45],仅具提示性。预测效度评分的权重与函数形式尚未最终确定,实证拟合属于议程中的未来工作。

Conclusion: 论文明确将自身定位为综合性的立场论文,未开展新的对照实验。主要局限:(1)预测效度主张未经受控随机试验验证;(2)证据局限于工业资产业务领域,12层正交性是工作假设;(3)无真实部署结果(操作员覆盖、事件减少、误报率)闭环验证;(4)14项实现研究本身为未发表的实施报告而非同行评审论文。给出现场的4项建议:申报配置而非仅模型、按迁移排名、按均值排名、必备法官独立锚点、采用持久非stdio基础设施。核心主张:"排行榜与其所建议的部署之间需要建立不同的关系"。

Abstract: Agent benchmarks are growing fast, but no single benchmark touches more than four or five of the dimensions that deployment exposes. This paper aggregates the largest coordinated deep-dive of one MCP-based industrial-agent benchmark to date: fourteen parallel implementation studies covering new asset classes (including a multi-modal visual extension), alternative orchestrations, retrieval strategies, reasoning modes, infrastructure optimizations, and evaluation-methodology probes. Consolidating those studies with seven prior agent benchmarks, we argue that aggregate-score leaderboards systematically underspecify deployed-agent evaluation. Rankings derived from aggregate scores do not transfer to out-of-distribution settings; recent public-to-hidden competition retrospectives provide direct empirical evidence of this rank instability. We propose ranking configurations by predictive validity, the correlation between in-sample and out-of-sample rank, rather than in-sample mean, and report a twelve-tier measurement apparatus that exposes the deployment-relevant dimensions HELM and its agent-era successors collapse. The position is operationalized through three falsifiable out-of-distribution criteria with explicit thresholds; existing evidence partly supports it but is too thin to confirm. We close with a pre-registered pilot design and a field-level vision for what the next generation of agentic benchmarks should report.

</details>


### [271] [GLARE: A Natural Language Interface for Querying Global Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19735)
*Bhavan Vasu,Rajesh Mangannavar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GLARE是一个基于LLM的交互式自然语言接口，允许用户通过自然语言问题查询黑盒图像分类器的全局解释（global explanations）。系统核心LLM充当"中介者"，将自然语言问题翻译为针对局部解释数据的结构化SQL查询，从而实现灵活的聚合分析而无需用户接触底层表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代全局解释方法（如DNF公式、决策树）通常规模庞大、逻辑规则数以千计，形成"解释倾倒"（explanation dump），导致用户认知超载，掩盖了关键洞见。实际场景中，用户需要的是针对具体假设的迭代式、查询驱动的探索（例如"模型是否依赖背景雪来分类狼？"），而非静态的完整摘要。现有XAI工具要求用户手动过滤和聚合局部解释，摩擦大、实用性受限。论文主张：用户的解释寻求行为本质上是迭代的查询过程，全局解释应被视为"可查询的数据库"而非"可查看的静态产物"。

Method: 1. **系统架构**：采用parse-validate-execute三阶段管道。用户输入自然语言问题 → LLM查询解释器（基于Gemma 2/Qwen 2.5，使用QLoRA微调）将其映射到24个预定义SQL查询模板 → 模板参数化实例化 → 验证后执行 → 返回统计增强的自然语言响应、局部解释图像和意图对齐的可视化。2. **底层数据**：将Vasu等人[21]的mDNF全局解释（基于最小充分解释MSX聚合的析取范式）摄取到关系数据库中。3. **核心创新-SQL Fence Masking**：自定义SqlFenceCollator在微调时将损失函数mask限定在SQL_START和SQL_END标记之间的token上，迫使模型学习SQL的关系代数结构而非记忆数据集特定实体名，从而支持零样本跨数据集迁移。4. **训练数据合成**：基于24个查询模板，从ADE20K词表（150个物体、35个场景）随机采样生成50,000训练对和2,000验证对，包含同义词替换和多样化短语模板。5. **查询模板分三层**：Core（核心，如频率、布尔组合、top-k、共现）、Extended（扩展，如N路自连接、跨类比较、集合运算）、Contrastive（对比，如缺席分析、阈值查询、类别区分特征）。6. **评估模型**：Gemma 2（2B/9B/27B）和Qwen 2.5（0.5B/7B/14B），统一使用QLoRA（rank=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05）和4-bit量化。

Result: **（1）分布内准确率**：在500例Fresh Test上，Gemma 2 9B实现100%结构指标（fence/parse/exec）和95.2% result-match，加上2.4% partial match后有效精度>97%。Gemma 2 2B/27B同样达到~95.2%匹配率，表明在Gemma家族内in-distribution性能饱和。正则表达式基线虽然结构指标100%但match仅74.4%。基础模型（未微调）匹配率近乎为零，确认泛化来源于任务微调。Qwen 2.5 0.5B即使微调后仍失败（4.4%），确认存在最小容量阈值。**（2）鲁棒性（7种扰动）**：Gemma 2 9B在拼写错误上保持79.6% match vs 正则的48.7%（+31pp），同义词替换零退化，paraphrase一致性94.1%，1485项sanity检查100%通过。**（3）OOD泛化（300例）**：整体执行率99.3%，phrasing variations 45.1% match，novel SQL constructs 19.5% match。能组合已学片段（chained_filter 100%、string_pattern 100%），但无法外推至真正未见过的语法（window_function、case_expression等0%）。**（4）跨数据集迁移**：在Pascal VOC（166个不同物体、迥异场景分类）上零样本测试，Gemma 2 9B达89.6% match，Gemma 2 27B达90.6%，25种查询类型中有17种≥95%准确率。**（5）跨模型对比**：Gemma 2 9B与Qwen 2.5 7B架构不同但Fresh Test准确率相近（95.2% vs 93.0%），证明pipeline architecture-agnostic。

Conclusion: GLARE将全局解释的消费从被动检查静态产物转变为基于查询的主动对话式探索。通过将生成约束在固定关系模式上的SQL中间表示上，系统在保证组合表达力与形式正确性的同时，对无编程经验的用户保持可及性。合成训练管道与fence-masked微调具有架构无关性，无需人工标注且仅需提供实体名列表即可零样本迁移到新数据集。经验上，≥7B参数的小型微调模型在分布内查询上达到>95%准确率，在未见域迁移时达到~90%准确率，并对语言扰动保持高鲁棒性。局限性在于模板分类法虽可扩展但尚不穷尽，扩展至额外SQL结构只需在合成生成器中追加即可。整体表明LLM中介的查询为人本XAI工作流中更易用的全局解释提供了实用可靠的路径。

Abstract: While global explanations are crucial for understanding vision models across datasets, classes, and decision contexts, their complex and monolithic nature often hinders practical exploration. Because users typically seek targeted answers to specific questions rather than static artifacts, we present an LLM-based interactive interface that provides natural language access to global explanations for black-box image classifiers. The system's core LLM acts as a mediator, translating natural language questions into structured SQL queries over local explanation data. This enables flexible aggregation without exposing users to low-level representations. For each query, the interface outputs statistics-augmented natural language responses, supporting local explanations, and intent-aligned visualizations. We evaluate the system on intent interpretation, query mapping accuracy, generalization to novel queries and datasets, and robustness to linguistic errors. Our results demonstrate that LLM-mediated querying substantially improves the accessibility and usability of global explanations for human-centered XAI.

</details>


### [272] [Interpreting Neural Combinatorial Optimization via Evolving Programmatic Bottlenecks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19741)
*Haocheng Duan,Yuxin Guo,Jieyi Bi,Anqi Xie,Sirui Li,Yining Ma,Cathy Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Evolving Programmatic Bottlenecks (EPB)，将黑盒神经组合优化(NCO)模型蒸馏为可由LLM自主演化的可读程序组合，并通过状态相关的路由器在各决策步骤动态组合这些程序，从而实现对NCO策略的可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经组合优化(NCO)虽性能优异但缺乏可解释性，阻碍其部署与科学诊断。现有Concept Bottleneck Models (CBM)等可解释性工具难以直接适用于NCO，因为：(1) NCO的决策是动态、状态依赖的；(2) 不存在预定义的"概念词汇表"；(3) 经典的运筹学启发式本身是完整的决策算法而非原子概念。因此需要新的可解释性范式来揭示NCO策略的内部决策逻辑。

Method: EPB框架包含两大模块：(1) 程序银行：由LLM生成并维护一组可执行的启发式程序，每个程序输出每步动作分布；(2) 状态依赖路由器(OCDR)：基于scaled-dot-product attention，根据当前状态为每个程序分配权重。优化采用两阶段嵌套方案——Block I(固定容量)：混合文本-数值梯度下降，路由参数用SGD更新，程序通过TextGrad进行文本梯度更新；Block II(动态容量)：通过故障导向的Add添加专家，通过冗余导向的Drop剪枝。该方法将NCO策略蒸馏为人类可读的程序组合，并自然适应NCO的序贯决策特性。

Result: 在POMO和LEHD教师模型上的TSP/CVRP实验中验证：(1) 蒸馏后的学生模型性能接近教师(搜索后差距0.03%-2.16%)；(2) POMO蒸馏的策略以阶段自适应逻辑为主，而LEHD蒸馏的策略以局部几何修正为主；(3) CVRP上策略随构建阶段从扇区划分转向容量感知选择再到贪心回仓；(4) 蒸馏后的程序化代理在OOD场景(如TSP-500)上大幅优于原始教师(约-15%)，表明显式程序化蒸馏能过滤过拟合模式，提升泛化能力。

Conclusion: EPB成功将黑盒NCO策略转化为可读的程序组合，揭示了不同NCO求解器的决策结构差异(POMO偏阶段化，LEHD偏几何化)，并发现NCO行为在不同优化阶段发生转移。此外，可解释的程序化瓶颈不仅提升了透明度，还改善了OOD泛化能力，将可解释性从"可信工具"升格为"研究催化剂"。局限在于路由器仍是黑盒神经网络，未来可探索更透明或全程序化的路由机制。

Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) achieves strong performance, yet its black-box nature remains a key roadblock to deployment and scientific diagnosis. Standard interpretability tools, such as Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs), are ill-equipped for NCO, whose decisions are dynamic, state-dependent, and lack proper concept vocabulary definition. To close this gap, we introduce Evolving Programmatic Bottlenecks (EPB), to our knowledge, the first framework for interpreting NCO policies by distilling black-box NCO models into human-readable program portfolios. EPB employs an LLM to autonomously evolve a bank of programs, where each program's per-step action distribution serves as the bottleneck. EPB works through an iterative framework: Block I fixes program bank capacity and introduces a hybrid textual-numerical gradient descent scheme that couples numerical gradients for student router updates and textual gradients for LLM-based program revision; Block II dynamically adapts bank capacity via fault-targeted expansion and redundancy pruning. Extensive experiments demonstrate EPB's effectiveness and broad applicability, where the distilled program portfolios largely match original performance. EPB also reveals that NCO behavior shifts across optimization stages and can be approximated as a composition of classic heuristic variants. Our work advances interpretable NCO and establishes EPB as a promising tool for interpreting sequential decision-making models.

</details>


### [273] [A Comparative Study of Pretrained Transformer Models for Quranic ASR: Speech Representations, Label Formats, and Dataset Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19747)
*Nabil Mosharraf Hossain,Riasat Islam,Unaizah Obaidellah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于预训练Transformer模型（Wav2Vec2.0、HuBERT、XLS-R）的古兰经自动语音识别（ASR），通过在超过870小时的古兰经朗诵数据集上进行领域微调与消融实验，最佳模型在EveryAyah子集上达到WER 0.08，在EveryAyah+Tarteel组合设置上达到WER 0.11，较Citrinet基线（WER 0.163）提升约5个百分点，并将训练时间从140小时缩短至40小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古兰经ASR具有辅助背诵、语音搜索、辅助教学等重要应用价值。然而现有模型在用户朗诵场景下词错误率（WER）较高，且对古兰经全文覆盖率不足。传统方法（GMM-HMM）受限于数据规模和特征表达能力，而端到端深度学习模型在该领域尚未被充分探索。此外，Tajweed（诵读规则）的声学特性和专业诵读者与业余诵读者之间的差异性也未被系统建模。

Method: 研究采用三阶段方法论：（1）数据收集与预处理——整合EveryAyah.com的1310小时专业朗诵数据（44位知名诵读者，覆盖全部114章）和Tarteel.io的62小时用户录制数据，经1-30秒剪辑过滤后形成超过870小时的训练语料，以16kHz WAV格式标准化；（2）模型训练与微调——采用facebook/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53等预训练Transformer模型，冻结CNN编码器并微调24层Transformer解码器，使用CTC损失函数和贪婪解码，学习率3×10⁻⁵，dropout 0.1，SpecAugment正则化，并在NVIDIA Tesla P100上进行10-12个epoch训练；（3）评估与验证——通过WER和CER指标进行消融研究，系统比较不同特征提取器（Wav2Vec2.0/HuBERT/XLS-R/MFCC）、输出标签格式（阿拉伯文无/带Tashkeel、Buckwalter音译、英文音译）、训练策略（从头训练vs微调）、数据集组成（专业vs用户）及片段时长（10/20/30/40秒）对性能的影响。

Result: 实验结果表明：Wav2Vec2-large-XLSR-53在所有特征提取器中表现最优（WER 0.08，EveryAyah数据集），显著优于HuBERT（WER 0.52）和XLS-R（WER 0.09）；阿拉伯文无变音符号作为输出标签效果最佳（WER 0.08），而Buckwalter音译（WER 0.41）和英文音译（WER 0.38）表现较差；专业诵读者数据集优于用户录制数据（WER 0.23），但两者结合微调可实现良好泛化（WER 0.11）；30秒片段时长达到最佳平衡（WER 0.075），40秒则导致显存溢出；从头训练收敛缓慢（WER 0.9），而微调预训练模型在800步内即可降至0.3，2000步降至0.08；最佳配置较Citrinet基线（WER 0.163）提升约5个百分点，并将训练时间从140小时缩短至40小时。常见错误集中在音近字母混淆（如seen/saad）、短句辨识及Ghunnah（鼻音）和Maad（音长）等Tajweed相关声学特征识别困难。

Conclusion: 研究证实，预训练Transformer模型（特别是Wav2Vec2-large-XLSR-53）为古兰经语音识别提供了变革性优势，能显著降低转录错误并实现跨数据集和朗诵风格的泛化。然而，模型规模较大（1.2GB，约1亿参数）且推理延迟约为基线的3倍，限制了移动端部署；同时缺乏音素级分辨率，难以支持Tajweed纠正和发音分析等应用。未来工作应聚焦于：开发音素感知模型以支持Tajweed敏感应用、改进Tarteel用户数据质量、通过知识蒸馏、量化和剪枝实现模型轻量化，以及探索针对说话人年龄、性别或方言的个性化ASR模型。该研究为古兰经全篇章、无外部语言模型的Transformer基线建立了坚实基础。

Abstract: Quran Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) aims to convert Quranic recitation into text, enabling applications such as aided memorisation tools and Quranic search engines. However, existing ASR models often exhibit high Word Error Rates (WER) on user-recited verses and lack full coverage of the Quranic corpus. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of domain-specific fine-tuning of pretrained Transformer-based models for Quranic ASR, using advanced speech feature extraction methods: Wav2Vec2.0, HuBERT, and XLS-R. These models apply self-supervised learning by masking portions of input audio and using Transformer architectures to learn context-aware speech features. The pretrained models are fine-tuned on a filtered Quranic dataset exceeding 870 hours of professional and user recitations. Through comprehensive ablation studies across feature extractors, output label formats, training strategies, and clip durations, we identify the key factors that affect transcription accuracy in this domain. Our best-performing configuration achieves a WER of 0.08 on the EveryAyah subset and 0.11 on the combined EveryAyah+Tarteel setting, representing roughly a five-percentage-point gain over the Citrinet baseline (WER = 0.163) while reducing combined-model training time from 140 hours to 40 hours. Arabic text without diacritics yields the best fine-tuning results, and Wav2Vec2-XLSR-53 provides the strongest overall representation. Future work includes improving dataset quality and developing phoneme-aware models to extract deeper speech feature representations for Tajweed-sensitive applications.

</details>


### [274] [Benchmarking Agentic Review Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19749)
*Dang Nguyen,Wanqing Hao,Yanai Elazar,Chenhao Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对四种智能体式论文评审系统（OpenAIReview、'coarse、Reviewer3 及 zero-shot 基线）在六种大语言模型上进行了系统级基准测试，通过质量信号相关性、扰动错误检测和真实用户部署三个维度评估其能力，发现最强配置 OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5 在质量信号配对准确率上达 83.0%，在注入错误召回率上达 71.6%，且多模型联合可进一步将召回率提升至 83.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI 辅助研究的兴起，论文投稿量激增，同行评审体系面临"评审死亡螺旋"的压力。已有自动化评审系统不断涌现，但缺乏对其系统级而非单一模型的系统化评估，尤其是在真实论文上的对比基准，因此亟需建立标准化的评测方法来衡量这些代理式评审系统的实际能力。

Method: 研究在三个层面展开：（1）质量代理研究——在 ICLR/NeurIPS 真实论文上使用引用数、会议奖项、评审分数及其组合四类外部质量信号，测量系统对高低质量论文对的配对准确率；（2）扰动基准——在 8 个 arXiv 学科领域的 74 篇 LaTeX 源论文中，通过提取-生成-验证-审查-注入五阶段流水线注入四类已知错误（表面数学错误、虚假声明、逻辑错误、实验错误），测量各系统的检测召回率，采用模糊子串匹配加 LLM 评判的两阶段评估；（3）真实部署研究——公开部署 OpenAIReview 收集 1,360 条评论的 690 次用户投票反馈。共评估了 6 个 LLM（2 个前沿模型 + 4 个高效模型）下的 4 种系统组合。

Result: （1）质量信号追踪：OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5 配对准确率最高（0.83），高于 zero-shot + DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Reviewer3（均为 0.80），'coarse 最弱（0.66），且所有系统均显著高于随机水平；GPT-5.5 在严重评论层级上仍保持 0.78（主要问题）和 0.91（中等问题）准确率。（2）扰动错误检测：OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5 召回率 71.6%，在所有错误类别上均最优，prose 级错误提升最显著（实验类从 67.0%→85.2%，声明类从 67.0%→83.3%），而表面数学错误提升有限；'coarse 和 Reviewer3 因优先排序策略反而低于 zero-shot；六模型联合召回率可达 83.3%（比最优单模型高 11.7 个百分点）。（3）段落级互补性：AI 与人类评审在评论段落上 Jaccard 仅 0.230，人类侧重新颖性等论文层面判断，AI 侧重表面、声明、实验等技术细节；不同后端模型评论互补（3-way Jaccard 0.316）。（4）用户反馈：1.44:1 正负投票比，4.9% 评论被标记为已解决，71% 的负票针对假阳性和琐碎吹毛求疵，精确度是主要短板。

Conclusion: 当前代理式评审系统已能在无需任务特定微调的情况下追踪人类质量信号，并能检测多数注入错误，展现出与人类评审互补的潜力（人类偏高层判断，AI 偏详尽技术列举）；模型组合在系统设计中具有显著提升空间，多模型联合可将召回率从 71.6% 提升至 83.3%。基准主要衡量召回率而未直接评估精确度，真实部署揭示精确度（假阳性、琐碎 nitpicks）才是更紧迫的限制，未来需通过更好的校准和提示工程解决；扰动流水线由 LLM 驱动，可能存在与评审模型共享的分布偏差，需要更大规模专家审计作为后续工作。

Abstract: A new class of agentic review systems are emerging as a remedy to the pressure placed on peer review systems by AI-assisted research, but it is unclear how they should be evaluated. We evaluate two open-source systems (OpenAIReview and coarse), one proprietary system (Reviewer3), and a zero-shot baseline, across six LLMs spanning frontier and efficient models. First, we study whether AI reviews on ICLR/NeurIPS papers track with papers' quality as approximated by external signals such as citations and acceptance decisions. Every system performs above chance in pairwise accuracy, and the best is OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5 at 83.0%. Second, to test whether systems can catch errors with known ground truth, we construct a perturbation benchmark that injects four categories of errors into papers across eight arXiv subject classes and measure detection recall. The strongest configuration (OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5) catches 71.6% of injected errors, leaving substantial room for improvement. The union of detections across six models reaches 83.3% recall, suggesting different models detect different errors and better harness design can potentially increase performance. Beyond these benchmarks, we study a public deployment of OpenAIReview with real users. Votes on its comments skew positive at 1.44 to 1, and the most common complaints are about false positives and minor nitpicks. Together, by evaluating full review systems backed by state-of-the-art models on real research papers, we show that while AI reviews still have room for improvement, they can already track human quality judgments well, catch important errors, and earn positive feedback from real users.

</details>


### [275] [Grounded Inference: Principles for Deterministically Encapsulated Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19753)
*Marty O'Neill*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Grounded Inference"（扎根推理）框架，通过定义四个原子原语（Probabilistic Engine、Model Encapsulator、State Registry、Deterministic Orchestrator）和两个反模式（将生成模型用作数据工作者、用作有状态机），为生成式模型安全集成到传统确定性计算系统中提供了一套完整的架构基础，并给出了参考实现（Adaptive Resolution Agent）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式模型（如LLM）表面看似可控有状态，实则是无状态的概率推理引擎，无法保证传统系统所要求的接口契约合规性。工业界早期采用者已付出巨大代价，但该领域仍缺乏去风险化地将AI融入传统系统的根基性框架。三大核心挑战：可复现性（GPU并行执行与浮点非结合性导致位级不可复现）、可解释性（统计权重取代离散逻辑树）、约束力（提示词可被统计覆盖而非强制执行）。因此迫切需要明确的执行边界定义。

Method: 1. 提出数据二分法：Order（结构化数据，可用确定性方法解析）与Entropy（非结构化数据，需语义推理）。2. 提出熵最小化原则：在数据摄取管线最早期将结构化元素路由至传统计算。3. 定义四大原语：Probabilistic Engine（无状态推理引擎）、Model Encapsulator（强制模式校验与重试预算的封装层）、State Registry（确定性状态存储）、Deterministic Orchestrator（传统业务流程编排）。4. 识别两个反模式并分析系统性失败。5. 给出Encapsulation Micro-Pattern封装微模式与Adaptive Resolution Agent参考架构（用于解析schema漂移），并定义Validation Micro-Pattern作为视觉审计启发法。6. 从服务层、分布式架构、内在随机性三个层面剖析生成式模型的不可复现性根源。

Result: 建立了一套完整的Grounded Inference架构体系：(1) 四大原子原语构成所有稳健AI混合架构的最小组合单元；(2) 两个反模式得到系统性解构——反模式A导致审计性丧失、Model-as-a-Service漏洞、静默退化、并发瓶颈与概率控制流风险，反模式B导致沉默状态修改与上下文崩溃（引用Liu et al.的U形性能曲线研究）；(3) 参考架构Adaptive Resolution Agent通过限制LLM仅用于合成确定性解析器（而非直接处理数据）、使用隔离沙箱执行语法与语义双重验证、利用Git Repo解耦生成合成与CI/CD管道，实现了反模式的机械反转；(4) 验证启发法：架构序列图中概率引擎应仅呈现为离散的瞬时激活闪烁，连续激活的生命线必须归属于确定性原语；(5) 量化了风险——零温设置下API模型仍可有高达15%的输出变化，后端推理引擎选择可导致高达16.6个百分点的基准分数波动。

Conclusion: 生成式概率引擎仅应用于弥补传统计算方法无法跨越的能力鸿沟。核心理论结论：概率引擎必须被严格视为无状态机；必须拒绝"信息直通"模式；每次调用前必须重置会话上下文；概率引擎仅与调用它的Model Encapsulator通信。对话式AI并非内在安全系统，而是依赖人类操作员充当带外Model Encapsulator来稳定的高波动系统；进入无人类干预的自主企业管线时，必须对概率引擎施加确定性约束。未来商业LLM提供商将确定性校验、认知接地与异步状态管理下沉至托管编排层，但基础模型本质上仍是无状态概率的。本框架为下一代生成式模型接口提供了架构基础。

Abstract: The incorporation of generative models into traditional computational systems presents both enormous opportunity and tremendous peril. Although many early adopters have realized these perils at great expense, the field still requires foundational frameworks to de-risk incorporation of AI into traditional systems. This manuscript establishes this foundation through the definition of four specific primitives of AI blended architecture, designed to enable deterministic encapsulation of probabilistic models. It further establishes two overarching anti-patterns broadly represented across industry to serve as warnings for engineers in this field. This framework was designed to enable successful integration of AI into traditional systems while providing a foundation upon which generative model providers could build the next generation of generative model interfaces.

</details>


### [276] [Optimal Scheduling in a Question-Answering Forum of Knowledge Workers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19759)
*Rohit Negi,Mustafa Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对未来采用专职"知识工作者"（专家）而非志愿者的问答（QA）论坛，提出基于排队论的容量分析与在线调度器设计。论文建模了有限主题集合上的请求-回答队列系统，分别在协调模式（专家各自独立处理不同请求）和协作模式（多位专家联合处理同一请求）下推导出系统容量的闭式表达式，并设计了联邦式贪心调度器证明可达到该容量。仿真基于真实StackExchange数据验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前以Quora和StackExchange为代表的QA论坛依赖志愿者贡献，导致大量问题无人回答（如StackExchange上16%的问题无人回答，54%未被标记为"已接受"），且回复质量参差不齐。随着ChatGPT等大语言模型的崛起，复杂问题对专职人类专家的需求日益凸显。本文设想一种"付费版"QA论坛——通过雇佣合约专家并使用调度器动态分配问题，以最大化系统容量并保证服务质量。即便该模式未能实现，所建模型的容量上界也能反映志愿者论坛的能力极限。

Method: 1. 排队论建模：时间分槽，主题集𝒳有限，请求a_x(t)按主题独立i.i.d.到达，负载λ可调；n位专家各有最大并发数n_i及主题相关的回答率q_i(x)，回答时间建模为均值1/q_i(x)的几何随机变量。2. 稳定性定义：基于Lyapunov分析的马尔可夫链正常返性。3. 协调模式（Section 3）：推导出容量闭式解（Lemma 1）；提出贪心在线协调调度器和在线到达调度器，二者均证明达到该容量。4. 协作模式（Section 4）：引入协作集𝒮与广义独立集约束ℐ，推导协作容量（Theorem 1）；将最优分配建模为超图分配问题（HAP，NP-hard），并设计两阶段贪心协作调度器提供近似比γ=1/max|S|的保证。5. 鲁棒性分析（Lemma 5）：在专家对自身回答率估计存在误差时仍保证系统稳定。6. 仿真验证：使用StackExchange 37个站点、180万条请求和27万条回答的实证数据，以及截断高斯模型的数值实验。

Result: 1. 协调容量闭式解（Lemma 1）：当存在某主题所有专家回答率为零时容量为零，否则由线性规划给出严格正的容量表达式。2. 协调容量上界λ*≤n；当每主题至少有N位专家回答率≥q时，λ*≥qN；若存在主题划分使所有主题被覆盖，则λ*≥q/p（Lemma 2）。3. 协作容量≥协调容量（Lemma 4a），且当协作能显著加速回答时存在c/|ℐ_cover|·max|S|倍的增益（Lemma 4b-c）。4. 两专家示例：协作使容量从0.02提升至1（50倍增益），定量验证了理论。5. 两阶段贪心调度器在协调场景下精确达到容量（γ=1），在协作场景下达到至少γ=1/max|S|倍容量。6. 真实StackExchange数据仿真显示两种联邦调度器在负载低于协调容量时队列长度稳定可控，且对回答时间是否几何分布及c_Q参数不敏感；数值实验表明专家专精度适中最优。

Conclusion: 论文成功地为基于专家雇佣的QA论坛建立了一套完整的容量理论与调度框架：两种联邦式调度器（贪心与到达式）均达到协调容量；协作模式在专家可互补时显著提升容量；理论结果在真实数据集和参数化数值实验中均得到验证。理论分析对志愿者驱动论坛的容量上限亦有参考意义。未来工作方向包括：(1) 考虑专家间具有任意社交图关系的QA系统；(2) 该图上的分布式调度算法设计；(3) 允许专家有一定选择权的混合系统。

Abstract: As individuals turn to the Internet to find answers to questions they may have, several Question Answering (QA) forums have evolved, where users knowledgeable in certain topics can contribute their expertise to answering these requests for information. While these are currently volunteer based, we consider a future version employing knowledge workers who are experts in certain topics. In such a system, the request-answer processes forming the queuing system may utilize schedulers that assign requests in different topics to the experts in the forum, who may be able to answer them according to their expertise levels in different topics. With this model, we calculate the capacity of the system for handling the requests while keeping the system stable, and design schedulers that achieve capacity. We also investigate how collaboration between experts in answering requests can potentially increase capacity.

</details>


### [277] [Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19771)
*Xuanzhi Feng,Zhengyang Li,Zeyu Liu,Haoxi Li,Yuming Jiang,Bing Guo,Jingcai Guo,Jie Zhang,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出ICT（Independent Combinatorial Tokens）框架，通过Jensen-Shannon散度识别logit分布偏离组平均分布的"独特token"作为关键分支点，对GRPO进行稀疏化策略更新（仅更新top 10%独特token），无需直接优化熵即可隐式控制策略纯度，在Qwen2.5系列（0.5B/1.5B/7B）上7个基准测试中平均pass@4提升4.58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR训练面临"熵坍缩-熵爆炸"二元困境：均匀token更新导致熵坍缩（过早收敛到次优策略），而过度最大化Shannon熵则导致熵爆炸（盲目探索至推理链不连贯）。现有方法依赖Shannon熵标量值选择关键token，但该指标仅反映不确定性而非探索方向，分布形态相异的概率分布可具有相同Shannon熵，导致探索信号模糊。从信息论角度，token的独特性（logit分布偏离组平均的程度）才是有效探索的根本驱动力。

Method: 1. **ICT分布选择器**：以组内G个采样在位置t的logit分布均值P_avg为参考，计算每个token的softmax分布与P_avg之间的Jensen-Shannon散度作为独特性分数u_{i,t}；取top-k百分位构造二值稀疏掩码M_{i,t}。2. **稀疏GRPO目标（Sparse-GRPO）**：仅对掩码为1的token计算策略梯度，按活跃token数归一化，而非按完整序列长度归一化。3. **预热机制**：前Θ步保持全token更新（warmup），之后切换到稀疏更新。4. **理论工具**：定义策略纯度β(π)=∑π(a)²（即碰撞概率/二阶Rényi熵的指数），证明独特token的JS高分与概率接近β(π)的一致性，并证明二阶Rényi熵梯度∇H₂ = -2E_{a~p²}[∇log π(a)]。5. **熵分支定理**：通过一阶Taylor展开证明ΔH₂ ≈ -2Δθ·π(a*)·(π(a*)/β(π) - 1)，当π(a*)>β(π)时熵减小（坍缩），π(a*)<β(π)时熵增大（爆炸），而独特token正位于两区域临界分界点。

Result: 1. **主实验**：Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/7B在Math500、GSM8K、MMLU-Stem、GPQA、AIME23/24/25共7个基准上全面优于GRPO、20-Entropy、STAPO基线，Pass@4平均提升3.38%/4.98%/3.94%（0.5B/1.5B/7B对应），最大增益14.9%。2. **Pass@1 vs Pass@4**：Pass@4增益显著大于Pass@1（7B模型：+4.38% vs +3.50%），表明ICT产生更丰富多样的正确推理路径而非冗余路径。3. **更新比例消融**：top-10%独特token更新在1.5B GSM8K上达P@1=66.23%、P@4=85.31%，优于10%/20%/30%及90%频繁token；JS散度分数在10%处有显著拐点。4. **熵组分验证**：独特token中高低熵token比例约为1:1（GSM8K:1.03, MATH:0.99），证实独特token同时来自两个分支区域，平衡熵动力学。5. **选择方法对比**：JS散度优于KL散度（P@1: 66.23% vs 58.64%）和Wasserstein距离（60.86%），随机选择10% token为63.65%也低于JS。6. **泛化性**：仅在数学数据训练，但GPQA（常识）性能同步提升，而20-Entropy在非数学域出现性能下降。7. **warmup鲁棒性**：在step 10/20/40激活稀疏更新均收敛至相近稳定奖励（0.6-0.8）。

Conclusion: 论文通过从标量Shannon熵转向token logit分布的Jensen-Shannon散度度量，建立了"独特token驱动有效探索"的理论与方法框架。核心贡献包括：(1) 提出基于JS散度的分布式token选择方法替代基于标量熵的启发式选择；(2) 理论证明对独特token的稀疏更新可同时调节Shannon熵与二阶Rényi熵，隐式防止熵坍缩和爆炸，无需直接优化熵指标；(3) 实证"少即是多"原则——仅更新10% token即可匹配或超越全参数训练，pass@4提升验证了探索多样性。局限在于理论分析基于一阶Taylor近似且依赖小步长假设，未充分建模多token耦合、负优势、AdamW动量等实际因素；未来工作将探索自适应token保留率、高效JS近似、跨模型族与任务域扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning; however, it faces a fundamental optimization instability: uniform token updates precipitate entropy collapse, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal strategies, whereas excessive Shannon Entropy maximization can cause entropy explosion, driving blind exploration toward incoherent reasoning chains. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce the Independent Combinatorial Tokens (ICT) framework, which shifts the optimization focus from scalar uncertainty to the distributional properties of token logits. By leveraging the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence between token logits distributions, ICT identifies tokens with distinctive distributional patterns as critical branching points for guiding effective exploration in LLM reasoning. Our theoretical analysis, grounded in both Shannon and second-order Rényi entropy, proves that selectively updating on these tokens regulates policy concentration: it reduces the overall distribution uncertainty measured by Shannon entropy, while controlling probability concentration captured by second-order Rényi entropy. This dual effect prevents over-concentrated token generation from weakening exploration and effectively stabilizes the training landscape. Empirical results demonstrate that updating only the top 10% of unique tokens on Qwen2.5 (0.5B/1.5B/7B) models yields an average pass@4 improvement of 4.58%, with a maximum gain of 14.9%, over GRPO, 20-Entropy, and STAPO baselines across seven benchmarks spanning math, commonsense, and Olympiad-level problems.

</details>


### [278] [AgentFinVQA: A Deployable Multi-Agent Pipeline for Auditable Financial Chart QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19782)
*Aravind Narayanan,Shaina Raza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentFinVQA 是一个面向受监管金融场景的多智能体图表问答流水线，通过规划、OCR、图例绑定、视觉检查与验证等阶段将每个查询分解执行，并将全部中间过程记录于可追溯的 Model Evaluation Packet (MEP) 中，从而同时实现可审计性与本地化部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融图表问答在高风险监管场景下仅靠"准确率"不够：从业者需要预知哪些答案值得信赖，且许多机构因数据合规无法使用外部模型 API。现有图表问答智能体多以准确率为目标、推理过程不透明，并普遍依赖专有 API，缺少同时满足可审计 + 可本地部署 + 无显著准确率损失的方案。

Method: 提出 AgentFinVQA 多智能体流水线，按固定顺序依次执行：Plan（纯文本 LLM 生成检查计划）→ OCR Reader（VLM 转录图表文本）→ Legend Grounder（图例颜色/样式映射）→ Colour-Area Tool（基于 HSV 掩膜的确定性像素计数，仅在条形/饼图等条件下门控触发）→ Vision Agent（CrewAI 编排的多选/多选-全选/开放式三类 prompt）→ Verifier（独立 VLM 二次审核，输出 CONFIRM/REVISE 及置信度，由置信度阈值 <0.75 的 Confidence Gate 抑制低置信修改）。每个样本的输入、输出、工具 trace 与时间戳全部写入可移植 JSON 工件 MEP，支持复现与事后溯源。所有阶段仅依赖 prompt，无需任务微调或本地 CV 模型；后端抽象支持 Gemini API、OpenAI 兼容端点及 vLLM 本地服务。

Result: 在 FinMME 上：Gemini-3 Flash 主干 +7.68 pp（71.24% vs 63.56%，McNemar p≈1.1×10⁻¹⁶），其中 MCQ +8.1 pp；本地化 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8（单卡 A100-80G，vLLM 部署）获得 +4.84 pp（p≈3.0×10⁻⁶）。Verifier 的 CONFIRM/REVISE 判定作为路由信号有效：确认答案精确准确率 68.2%，被修改答案仅 55.6%，可优先送人审 ~19% 输出。组件消融中，多选-全选 MCQ 专项支持带来最大单点增益（+23.3 pp），颜色-面积工具主要价值在于确定性锚定与审计溯源（激活率 5%）。错误分析显示：问题误解、图例混淆与数值提取错误占 Gemini-3 失败近三分之二，且恰是 Verifier 最难自检的类别；Qwen 因 Verifier 过度修改（41% vs 17%）使开放式问题无显著增益。

Conclusion: AgentFinVQA 证明在不依赖专有 API 的前提下，可同时实现金融图表问答的可审计性与本地部署，且能保留多智能体分解带来的主要准确率收益。Verifier 的二元判定为人在回路审核提供低成本路由信号；未来工作应聚焦问题理解、图例消歧与提取鲁棒性这三类 Verifier 难以自检的失败模式，并拓展至 FinChart-Bench、MME-Finance 等基准验证跨数据集泛化。

Abstract: Financial chart question answering in regulated settings demands more than accuracy: practitioners must know which answers to trust before acting on them, and many institutions cannot send client data to external model providers. Yet existing chart-QA agents are accuracy-focused and opaque, and most assume proprietary API access; to our knowledge, none combines auditability with on-premise deployability without significant accuracy compromise. We present AgentFinVQA, a multi-agent pipeline that decomposes each query into planning, OCR, legend grounding, visual inspection, and verification, recording every step in a traceable Model Evaluation Packet (MEP) per sample. On FinMME, AgentFinVQA improves $+7.68$ pp over a primary-backbone matched zero-shot baseline with a proprietary backbone (Gemini-3 Flash; 71.24% vs. 63.56%, McNemar $p \approx 1.1 \times 10^{-16}$), and $+4.84$ pp with open-weights Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 served locally. The verifier's verdict also serves as a useful confidence signal (68.2% vs. 55.6% exact accuracy on confirmed vs. revised answers), enabling human-in-the-loop review routing. Error analysis shows that question misunderstanding, legend confusion and extraction error account for nearly two-thirds of failures and are the categories least detected by the verifier, identifying clear directions for future work. Together these results show that auditable, on-premise financial chart QA is practical and that the open-weights system keeps most of the accuracy gains while enabling full data residency. We release our code to support reproducible evaluation.

</details>


### [279] [ORAgentBench: Can LLM Agents Solve Challenging Operations Research Tasks End to End?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19787)
*Jiajun Li,Mingshu Cai,Yixuan Li,Yu Ding,Ran Hou,Guanyu Nie,Xiongwei Han,Wanyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ORAgentBench是一个针对LLM智能体执行端到端运筹学(OR)任务的执行式基准测试,包含107个经过人工审核的任务,涵盖从自然语言简报到多文件数据、可执行环境和隐藏验证器的完整工作流。实验评估了14种前沿智能体-模型配置,结果显示当前最佳智能体仅能通过35.51%的任务和20.59%的困难任务,失败主要由策略性弱点(遗漏业务规则、脆弱建模、弱可行解构造、改进不足)而非编码能力造成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OR评估基准将建模与求解解耦,依赖预形式化或纯文本实例,无法测试从运营工件到验证决策的完整工作流。真实OR工作是端到端工程流程,需要领域专家、数据专家、建模求解专家和软件工程师的协调,缺乏对完整可执行OR工作流的评估使人们无法区分写出"似是而非方程"的智能体与真正完成运营OR工作的智能体。

Method: 基准通过四个阶段构建:场景选择与难度框架、任务与数据扩充、智能体辅助验证、人工审查。任务被形式化为τ=(D,C,q,E,V),包含输入数据、配置、自然语言简报、隔离沙箱环境和隐藏验证器。评分协议基于三维渐进评估:输出模式有效性(F)、硬约束可行性、归一化目标质量(q),通过阈值为F=1且q>0.4。难度通过六个构建议维度控制:求解策略需求、建模结构、约束耦合、动态结构、数据规模和问题理解。实验评估了14种模型-智能体配置(覆盖MiniMax-M2.7、Kimi K2.6、Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4等),使用Harbor隔离环境,45分钟交互预算加5分钟求解限制,并进行了技能增强研究(无技能/基础技能/专家技能)。

Result: RQ1显示GPT-5.4(Codex)以35.51%总体通过率和20.59%困难任务通过率领先,所有完成的智能体均低于35%,且可行性持续高于通过率,揭示"可行性-质量差距"。RQ2表明最佳表现者既不是最慢也不是最昂贵的,简单增加预算不能保证更好决策。RQ3失败模式诊断显示54.8%的非通过试验因建模策略失败,运输场景最难而软件/电信最容易。RQ4技能增强分析显示专家技能可改善困难任务可行性但难以可靠提升质量或通过率,专家技能带来3.85pp的困难任务通过率提升但易任务下降2.69pp,存在"通过转失败"多于"失败转通过"的现象。三次重复运行显示存在运行间变异性(pass@3比单次高15-19pp)。案例研究表明失败模式包括:语义验证器失配(局部"通过"日志放大虚假信心)、目标函数规范错误、共享资源建模不完整、严格不等式导致的时序边界偏差。

Conclusion: ORAgentBench作为执行式基准和诊断框架,揭示了当前LLM智能体距离可靠的自主OR实践还很远:许多失败源于缺失业务规则、脆弱建模、弱可行解构造和改进策略不足,而非编码本身。六个构建议维度表明OR难度不能简化为规模;建模结构、约束耦合、动态状态、数据规模和问题理解以不同方式压力测试不同智能体。未来OR智能体需要超越"似是而非的优化代码",实现可靠、高质量的运营决策,整合解释、优化、序列化和独立验证为统一工作流,并通过独立约束测试和外部边界对比来防止验证器失配。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for multi-step tasks in executable environments, yet their ability to perform realistic operations research (OR) work remains unclear. Existing OR evaluations often decouple modeling from solving, rely on pre-formalized or text-only instances, and rarely test the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions. In this work, we introduce ORAgentBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for evaluating autonomous agents on challenging end-to-end operations research tasks. It contains 107 human-reviewed tasks across diverse operational scenarios, each packaged in an isolated environment with a natural-language brief, multi-file data, configuration artifacts, and a required submission schema. Agents must write and run solution code, and their submissions are evaluated by hidden validators for schema validity, hard-constraint feasibility, and normalized objective quality. Experiments with fourteen frontier agent-model configurations show that current agents remain far from reliable OR practice. The best agent passes only 35.51% of all tasks and 20.59% of hard tasks, and many feasible submissions still fall below the required quality threshold. Failure analysis further shows that errors are dominated by strategic weaknesses, including missed operational rules, brittle formulations, weak feasible-solution construction, and insufficient solution improvement. OR-specific procedural skills increase hard-task feasibility, but do not reliably improve solution quality or pass rate. These results suggest that progress in OR agents requires moving beyond plausible optimization code toward dependable, high-quality operational decision-making.

</details>


### [280] [CombEval: A Framework for Evaluating Combinatorial Counting in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19788)
*Yuxu Zhou,Ondřej Kuželka,Yuyi Wang,Yuanhong Wang,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CombEval 是一个用于评估大语言模型组合计数(combinatorial counting, CO)能力的动态基准测试框架。它基于 Cofola 形式化规约语言自动生成自然语言计数问题，并通过求解器精确验证答案，系统性地评估了 11 个主流 LLM 在不同对象类型、规模、约束数量和推理深度下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 组合计数评估基准多为静态数据集，存在数据泄露(data contamination)和表面模式匹配(spurious reasoning)问题，导致对模型真实推理能力的高估。此外，组合计数问题具有结构多样、依赖专用数学工具、超出多项式时间复杂度等特点，难以构建可扩展的自动生成与验证框架。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 采用 Cofola 形式化语言，将每个问题表示为 ⟨D, O, C⟩ 三元组（实体域、组合对象集合、约束集合），支持 7 种对象类型（集合、袋、元组、序列、圆、划分、组合）和多种约束；(2) 通过将规约编译为加权一阶模型计数(WFOMC)实例，使用现成求解器实现精确答案验证；(3) 支持对象类型、实体规模、约束数量、推理深度的系统化变化，生成自然语言问题。评估了 11 个 LLM 在零样本和代码增强两种设置下的表现。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 模型规模和先进推理技术可提升整体准确率，但所有模型在无区分元素、有序结构、相对位置约束和嵌套对象依赖上仍表现脆弱；(2) CombEval 支持细粒度难度控制——增加实体规模、约束数量或对象依赖深度可预测地降低模型准确率；(3) 表面模板变化对较弱模型影响较大，而最强模型（gpt-5.5）对此类变化更稳健；(4) 错误分析揭示了模型在约束解释和计数原理上的失败模式。

Conclusion: CombEval 提供了一个动态、可控的诊断测试平台，可系统研究 LLM 在组合推理中的失败模式与原因。其基于形式化规约的方法有效缓解了数据污染和表面模式匹配问题，为组合计数能力的细粒度评估提供了新范式。代码与基准套件已开源。

Abstract: We present CombEval, a dynamic benchmark for evaluating combinatorial counting in large language models. CombEval represents each problem as a typed Cofola specification over entities, combinatorial objects, object dependencies, and constraints, enabling controlled generation of natural-language counting problems with exact solver-verified answers. Unlike static collections, CombEval supports systematic variation of object type, entity scale, constraint count, and reasoning depth. We evaluate 11 LLMs under direct and code-augmented settings and find that models remain brittle on ordered objects, indistinguishable elements, relatively positional constraints, and nested object dependencies. Error analysis further identifies failures in constraint interpretation and counting principles. CombEval provides a diagnostic testbed for studying when and why LLMs fail at combinatorial reasoning. The code and generated benchmark suites are publicly available at \url{ this https URL }.

</details>


### [281] [Think Again or Think Longer? Selective Verification for Budget-Aware Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19808)
*Sajib Acharjee Dip,Dawei Zhou,Liqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SeVRA（Selective Verification for Reasoning Allocation），一个服务层控制器，通过可恢复性感知门控决定是否对冻结求解器的初始答案保留或启动主动验证。研究发现选择性验证是测试后最强的恢复策略（减少有害翻转和验证 token），但在数学基准上更长初始推理在计算效率上更优；部署应先调优初始预算，再按需使用选择性恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时推理并非普适有利：额外的推理既可修复失败尝试，也可能在正确答案上浪费算力或产生有害的答案更改（right-to-wrong flips）。现有工作多聚焦于新验证器设计，但本文将其重新定位为部署分配问题：观察初始尝试后，冻结求解器应保留答案还是调用一次验证？核心信号不是难度或不确定性，而是当前尝试在特定干预下是否可恢复。

Method: 使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B 求解器，在 2,000 个 MATH 训练样本上对三种后生成动作（continuation、critique-and-repair、active verification）进行筛选，主动验证因最佳的修复-翻转权衡被选为主要干预。主动验证提示要求同一冻结求解器构造并执行至少两个候选特定检查（方程重构、单位检查、约束验证、代入验证等），通过则保留答案，否则修复。训练三类可恢复性门控：廉价特征门控（logistic，使用完成状态、token 数、finalizer 使用等可观测信号）、Qwen3-0.6B 与 1.7B 的 4-bit QLoRA 序列分类器。标签为观察到的 helpful-fix 指标（错误→正确），阈值在 MATH 开发集上基于下游策略准确率选择，且在 MATH500/GSM8K 评估前冻结。报告已实现总模型 token（含 prompt、生成和 finalizer 调用），而非配置最大预算。

Result: 在 MATH500 上，选择性主动验证达 76.3% 准确率（最佳测试后策略），相比 always-verify（75.5%）减少 26.8% 验证 token，有害翻转从 2.2% 降至 1.0%（p<.001）；但 8,192-token 初始求解达 76.0% 准确率却少用 28% 总 token。在 GSM8K 冻结迁移中，选择性策略仅验证 3.0% 样本，准确率从 93.4% 升至 94.5%，减少 91.2% 验证 token 且消除有害翻转，但仍被长初始预算追平。在 CommonsenseQA 上，always-on 验证反而降低准确率 4.17 个百分点且有害翻转达 5.94%，Self-Consistency@5 提升 1.88 点但代价约 5 倍 token。廉价特征门控与 1.7B 学习门控差距仅 0.4 点（MATH500），GSM8K 上完全持平，凸显部署实用性。初始预算扫描（4096→6144→8192）显示单调提升：更长初始预算减少截断和 finalizer 调用。

Conclusion: 附加推理应被视为价值不确定的干预，而非普适有益的扩展。可恢复性感知的选择性能显著减少不必要验证和有害答案变化，主动验证比简单继续尝试更有效。然而，在测试的数学成本前沿上，更长初始推理是最具计算效率的策略。实际部署规则为：先调优初始推理预算，再在需要显式验证、有界重试、可审计性或回归风险控制的场景中使用选择性恢复。整体应对完整服务路径（基础求解、干预提示、finalizer、重试、额外调用、已实现总 token）进行评估，并将答案变化视为可靠性风险而非仅聚合准确率变化。

Abstract: Test-time reasoning is increasingly used as a serving-time control knob, but extra reasoning is not uniformly valuable: it can repair failed attempts, waste compute on already-correct answers, or introduce harmful answer changes. We study this as a deployment allocation problem rather than a new-verifier problem. We introduce \sevra, Selective Verification for Reasoning Allocation, a serving-layer controller that decides whether to preserve a frozen solver's initial answer or invoke active verification. Using a frozen Qwen3-4B solver, we log intervention outcomes and train recoverability-aware gates from serving-visible attempt state. On \mathfive, selective verification reaches 76.3\% accuracy, compared with 75.5\% for always verifying, while reducing post-generation tokens by 26.8\% and harmful flips from 2.2\% to 1.0\%. However, an 8,192-token initial solve reaches 76.0\% accuracy with 28\% fewer total model tokens, showing that selective recovery is useful but not the best tested cost frontier. In frozen transfer to \gsm, the selective policy verifies only 3.0\% of examples, improves accuracy from 93.4\% to 94.5\%, and reduces verification tokens by 91.2\% relative to always verifying; again, a longer initial solve matches its accuracy with fewer realized tokens. On CommonsenseQA, always-on verification hurts, while Self-Consistency@5 improves accuracy at about five times the realized token cost. The resulting deployment rule is: tune the initial budget first, then use selective recovery when explicit checks, bounded retries, auditability, or regression-risk control matter.

</details>


### [282] [Human-on-the-Loop Orchestration for AI-Assisted Legal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19812)
*Anushree Sinha,Srivaths Ranganathan,Abhishek Dharmaratnakar,Debanshu Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"人在回路(HOTL)"编排框架，通过四层验证架构（规划验证、逐步推理检查点、执行沙箱、不确定性门控升级）来拦截自主LLM智能体在电子证据发现(e-discovery)中的"轨迹崩溃(trajectory collapse)"——即早期错误分类沿多步推理链静默传播的现象。基于5,000份合成语料的模拟实验表明，校准后的不确定性阈值τ_esc=0.5可将特权豁免风险(PWR)从自主基线的8.3%降至3.2%(降低61%)，同时仅将23.7%的文档路由给律师审查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主LLM智能体正被部署于e-discovery(依据《联邦民事诉讼规则》审查百万级文档)。然而，智能体工作流(agentic workflow)中t时刻的输出会条件化t+1时刻的查询，使得单次错误分类沿推理链静默传播，作者将此现象命名为"轨迹崩溃"。现有RLHF优化LLM还存在"流畅性陷阱"(为错误分类生成流畅自信的辩护)和"可解性幻觉"(在任务不可解时虚构工具调用)。传统端点指标(精确率/召回率/F1)在轨迹终点衡量，无法捕捉这类沿轨迹传播的失败，可能构成法律渎职(malpractice)。

Method: 提出三项贡献：(1) 按功能阶段(规划/检索/推理/执行)组织的智能体失败分类法，包括Fact Derive、Task Decompose、Query/Context/Summarize Misalign、Solvability Hallucination、Reasoning Trap、Missing Tool、Fluency Trap等失败模式；(2) 四层验证架构——①规划验证(f_plan为微调DeBERTa-v3分类器，2,400个三元组训练，τ_plan=0.70，ECE=0.04)、②逐步推理检查点(基于k=20次蒙特卡洛 rollout的优势函数A_t，低于阈值则重采样)、③执行沙箱(FRCP合规性拒绝列表策略引擎，配合数据库事务与补偿事务)、④不确定性门控升级(贝叶斯分解，使用k=10次自洽性方差估计认知不确定性U_ep，ECE=0.06、Brier=0.11)；(3) 在5,000份双律师标注的合成e-discovery语料上对比三组条件：自主(A)、阈值HOTL(T-HOTL，τ_esc∈{0.3,0.5,0.7})、全人工(M)，采用PWR、ER、FEP、RRR四个轨迹完整性指标。

Result: 在5,000份合成文档上：自主基线PWR=8.3%[7.1,9.5]，T-HOTL在τ=0.7时PWR=5.1%(ER=12.4%)，τ=0.5时PWR=3.2%[2.5,3.9](ER=23.7%，置信区间不重叠)，τ=0.3时PWR=1.7%(ER=47.9%)，全人工M=0.4%[0.1,0.8](ER=100%)。T-HOTL在τ=0.5下实现PWR降低61%且仅升级不到1/4文档。所有T-HOTL条件平均RRR=0.71，确认推理检查点成功恢复了多数被拦截的轨迹而无需升级。自主条件下平均FEP=3.2步(平均轨迹长度7.8步)，表明错误倾向于早期产生并大量复合。在τ=0.5下端到端处理平均14.2秒/文档(批量并行)，相对可比的PWR下律师工时估算减少76%。

Conclusion: 智能体化法律发现引入了"轨迹崩溃"这一复合失败类别，传统端点指标无法捕捉。所提出的四层验证架构(规划、推理、执行、不确定性门控)通过强制HOTL升级协议将轨迹完整性(trajectory integrity)确立为一阶设计目标，模拟结果显示其相对自主部署可将PWR降低高达61%且律师审查负担低于1/4。这是部署生产级智能体法律IR系统的前提条件。局限：语料为合成且缺乏标注者一致性κ；未做各层消融实验；GPT-4o存在特权文档的数据治理问题，需本地化或零出站推理；未来工作将基于真实发现语料并整合TAPE/KAIJU类形式化保障后端。

Abstract: Autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in electronic discovery (e-discovery), where compounding errors across multi-step reasoning chains can constitute legal malpractice. Unlike single-turn retrieval, agentic workflows operating over privileged document corpora exhibit a class of failure we term "trajectory collapse": an early misclassification silently propagates, rendering an entire privilege review invalid. This paper makes three contributions. First, we propose a structured taxonomy of agentic failures in legal information retrieval, organized by functional stage. Second, we introduce a four-layer verification architecture -- spanning planning, reasoning, execution, and uncertainty quantification -- designed to intercept these failures before they compound. Third, we present a preliminary simulation study on a synthetic e-discovery corpus that demonstrates how mandatory Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) escalation thresholds reduce privilege-waiver risk relative to fully autonomous baselines. Our results suggest that calibrated uncertainty thresholds can reduce privilege-waiver risk by up to 61% versus fully autonomous deployment, while routing fewer than one quarter of documents to attorney review.

</details>


### [283] [TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19821)
*Geon Kim,Dara Ron,Sukhdeep Singh,Suyog Moogi,Pranshav Gajjar,V V N K Someswara Rao Koduri,Een Kee Hong,Vijay K. Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TelcoAgent是一个基于基础模型的框架，用于5G网络中多KPM（关键性能测量）的可扩展、可解释预测。它结合了3GPP知识图谱、时序基础模型（TSFM）和ReAct推理代理，实现了无需站点特定训练的零样本多KPM预测，并提供基于领域知识的可操作诊断建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法在5G网络KPM预测中面临三大瓶颈：(1)难以捕捉KPM间的非线性跨通道依赖；(2)依赖逐站点训练导致计算开销大、扩展性差；(3)缺乏领域知识支撑的推理能力，仅输出预测而无根因诊断，无法满足主动网络管理的可操作性需求。

Method: TelcoAgent由三大流水线组成：(1)知识图谱构建流水线——通过提取器、对齐器、评估器三个LLM智能体，从13份3GPP规范文档（TS 28.552/38.211-215/38.300-331等）中自动构建本体化知识图谱，置信度阈值q_TH=0.9；(2)预测流水线——基于时序基础模型（Chronos-2/Moirai/MOMENT）进行零样本多通道联合预测，输入窗口81天，预测7天；(3)解释流水线——采用ReAct范式，利用PAX-TS计算跨通道敏感度矩阵，结合3GPP有向因果链和OpenStreetMap空间上下文，进行根因定位与可操作建议生成，并包含自动化自验证步骤（33项指标交叉核验）。

Result: 基于美国某运营商200个基站、3个月（2025年9-11月）、小时粒度的真实5G数据集评估：(1)预测精度——Chronos-2在全部7个KPM（RRC、CQI、iBLER、rBLER、MAC吞吐量、PRB利用率、IP吞吐量）的nRMSE和MASE上均最优，显著优于Moirai、MOMENT及N-BEATS、MLP、GRU等监督基线；(2)解释质量——平均Faithfulness=0.615、Answer Relevancy=0.807；移除知识图谱使Answer Relevancy下降7.4%；数值验证准确率达99.8%（200个基站×33项指标）。

Conclusion: TelcoAgent证明了零样本可扩展性与规范驱动的可解释性可在无需站点特定重训练或人工验证的前提下融合实现。未来工作将扩展知识图谱覆盖范围、引入邻基站时空上下文，并计划将TelcoAgent部署为O-RAN rApp用于闭环资源编排。

Abstract: Key Performance Measurement (KPM) forecasting is essential for proactive network management of 5G and next-generation telecom networks. However, existing machine learning (ML) approaches face significant limitations in scalability and explainability, restricting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. We propose TelcoAgent, a foundation model-based framework that enables accurate, scalable, and explainable forecasting of multiple KPMs across diverse network cells without the need for site-specific training. Specifically, the framework comprises three key components: (i) an automated three-agent pipeline that constructs a 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) knowledge graph directly from specification documents, (ii) a scalable, time-series foundation model (TSFM)-based prediction pipeline to deliver accurate, zero-shot forecasting, and finally (iii) a reasoning and explanation pipeline that provides actionable, domain-grounded diagnostics. Evaluated using a 3-month, real-world, city-scale 5G KPM dataset from a U.S.-based network operator, TelcoAgent demonstrates high forecasting accuracy for all 7 considered KPMs per cell across 200 cells, while delivering explainable insights and actionable instructions to address network degradations.

</details>


### [284] [A Systematic Evaluation of Black-Box Uncertainty Estimation Methods for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19868)
*Jiayi Wang,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对大语言模型（LLMs）的黑箱不确定性估计（UE）方法进行了系统综述，将现有方法归纳为五类，并在统一评估框架下对24种代表性方法、4个模型和4个数据集设置进行了基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM输出常出现幻觉（hallucinations）并缺乏可靠性，不确定性估计对构建可信LLM至关重要。然而，由于许多主流LLM仅通过受限API访问（无法获取logits和隐藏状态），黑箱UE方法在实际应用中尤为重要。现有黑箱UE研究方法分散，缺乏统一的实证比较，亟需系统化的综述与基准评估。

Method: 1. 系统综述：将黑箱UE方法组织为五类——基于语言化（verbalization-based）、基于采样（sampling-based）、基于解释（explanation-based）、多智能体（multi-agent）和混合方法（hybrid methods）。2. 构建统一评估框架。3. 在4个模型和4个数据集设置上对24种代表性方法进行基准测试。

Result: 1. 没有任何单一方法在所有设置下始终表现最优。2. 在答案空间中进行推理和候选比较的方法通常较为有效。3. 结合多种不确定性信号的混合方法在大多数条件下表现良好。

Conclusion: 本文通过发布基准数据和统一评估框架，促进可重复的比较并支持未来研究；其经验发现为未来黑箱UE方法的开发提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, their outputs often remain unreliable and may contain hallucinations, making uncertainty estimation (UE) essential for building trustworthy LLMs. In practice, many mainstream LLMs are only accessible through restricted APIs, where internal signals such as logits and hidden states are unavailable, making black-box UE especially important. However, existing work on black-box UE for LLMs remains fragmented in methodology and lacks a unified empirical comparison. To address this gap, we present a systematic review of black-box UE methods and organize them into five categories: verbalization-based, sampling-based, explanation-based, multi-agent, and hybrid methods. We further build a unified evaluation framework and benchmark 24 representative methods across 4 models and 4 dataset settings. Our results show that no single method consistently dominates across all settings. Nevertheless, methods that reason over and compare candidates in the answer space are generally effective, and hybrid methods that combine multiple uncertainty signals perform well under most conditions. By releasing the benchmark data and a unified evaluation framework, we aim to facilitate reproducible comparisons and support future research, while our empirical findings provide practical guidance for developing future black-box UE methods for LLMs.

</details>


### [285] [MetaResearcher: Scaling Deep Research via Self-Reflective Reinforcement Learning in Adversarial Virtual Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19893)
*Wei Yu,Suxing Liu,Minjie Yu,Jiahao Wang,Zhijian Zheng,Haocheng Deng,Bing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaResearcher 提出一个在四个协同维度上扩展深度研究智能体训练的框架：演化虚拟世界（注入时序动态与对抗性错误信息）、发现导向任务（超越事实检索的假设生成与矛盾消解）、自反思元奖励机制（在 GRPO 中联合优化正确性、效率、反思深度与工具多样性）、以及异构多智能体集群（Scout/Filter/Synthesizer 三个 4B 专业化模型通过协调强化学习协作）。该框架基于 LiteResearcher 基础设施构建，训练零边际 API 成本，面向 GAIA/Xbench-DS 基准性能与对抗条件下的认知鲁棒性双目标提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度研究智能体训练范式存在四项根本性局限：(1) 静态训练环境——LiteResearcher 基于约 3200 万网页构建的虚拟世界冻结后不再演化，智能体无法学习处理真实研究中普遍存在的时序动态与信息冲突；(2) 事实检索中心化任务——聚合、枚举、比较、多跳推理与工具使用五大原子能力本质上只在寻找"已有答案"，无法培养假设生成或矛盾消解等高阶研究技能；(3) 仅基于结果的奖励信号——纯结果 GRPO 训练导致重复动作循环等已知失败模式，智能体反复以微小查询变体重访相同搜索结果而不进行战略性探索；(4) 单体智能体架构——单一模型同时承担查询构建、相关性过滤与信息综合，违背人类研究团队中专业化分工的分布式结构，限制了性能上限。

Method: 框架包含四个协同创新维度：(1) 演化虚拟世界——在 Milvus 本地搜索引擎中引入版本化文档（论文预印本→勘误→复制研究）、时间索引与事件脚本（撤稿、共识转变），同时注入高可信度错误信息、矛盾专家观点与段落级细微操纵等对抗内容；(2) 发现导向任务——包含假设生成（跨领域识别潜在联系）、矛盾消解（证据加权合成冲突来源）与知识缺口识别（识别文献中真正缺失的信息），采用基于 pass@8 的难度校准课程学习；(3) 自反思元奖励——在 GRPO 框架内联合优化四项组件：R_correctness（二元结果奖励）、R_efficiency（基于步数的分段衰减函数）、R_reflection（回溯指示、策略变化、源多样性比率）、R_diversity（独特查询/域占比），通过加权聚合形成 R_meta 信号；(4) 异构多智能体集群——三个 4B 专业化模型（Scout 负责查询构建、Filter 负责相关性评估、Synthesizer 负责信息综合）通过共享证据库与学习到的通信协议协作，训练损失为个体 GRPO 损失之和加上 λ 加权的团队级损失，使用 Qwen2.5-4B-Instruct 作为基础模型，8×A100-80GB 约 2000 GPU-小时。

Result: 本文为框架设计论文，未报告实际实验结果，仅提出五项可检验假设：H1 整体集成后 GAIA≥73.0%（较 LiteResearcher 71.3% 提升 1.7 个百分点）；H2 演化世界使认知鲁棒性基准提升 20%；H3 元奖励机制使重复动作循环下降 50%；H4 多智能体集群联合性能优于单体智能体；H5 发现导向任务训练不影响标准基准性能。计划进行四组消融研究（环境、奖励、架构、任务）并在三类基准（GAIA/Xbench-DS 标准基准、新建认知鲁棒性基准、发现任务基准）上验证。论文附带预测训练动力学曲线显示元奖励较仅结果基线加速改善且循环次数显著下降。

Conclusion: MetaResearcher 在四个维度系统性地解决了 LiteResearcher 的根本局限，将认知脆弱性视为训练目标而非仅评估对象，以过程级奖励替代结果级奖励以更好对齐真实研究质量，验证专业化模块化系统相较单体模型的可扩展优势。框架继承零边际成本训练范式，代码、训练模型与数据将作为 LiteResearcher 项目开源扩展发布。该四维方法论代表深度研究智能体向科学发现真正协作者演进的有意义一步。

Abstract: Deep research agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in autonomous information gathering and synthesis, yet their training remains constrained by the static nature of simulated environments, the limits of fact-retrieval-only task designs, and the inefficiency of outcome-based reinforcement learning. In this work, we propose MetaResearcher, a novel framework that scales deep research agent training across four synergistic dimensions. First, we introduce an Evolving Virtual World that injects temporal dynamics and adversarial misinformation into the training environment, forcing agents to develop source credibility assessment and temporal conflict resolution skills. Second, we design Discovery-Oriented Tasks -- including hypothesis generation and contradiction resolution -- that transcend simple fact retrieval and push agents toward genuine research behaviors. Third, we propose a Self-Reflective Meta-Reward mechanism within the GRPO framework that jointly optimizes for answer correctness, search path efficiency, reflection depth, and tool call diversity, directly addressing the repetitive action loop problem observed in prior work. Fourth, we introduce a Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Swarm architecture comprising specialized Scout, Filter, and Synthesizer models that learn collaborative research strategies through coordinated reinforcement learning. Built upon the LiteResearcher infrastructure, MetaResearcher requires zero marginal API cost for training while targeting substantial improvements in both benchmark performance (GAIA, Xbench-DS) and epistemic robustness under adversarial conditions. We present the complete framework design, training methodology, and planned experimental validation.

</details>


### [286] [Multi-Agent Transactive Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19911)
*To Eun Kim,Xuhong He,Dishank Jain,Ambuj Agrawal,Negar Arabzadeh,Fernando Diaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM)框架，将LLM智能体生成的交互轨迹组织为群体级共享记忆库，通过状态条件的键值索引与学习排序重排，使异构消费者智能体能复用生产者轨迹的程序性知识，在ALFWorld和WebArena上同时提升了任务成功率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM智能体常依赖推理时缩放产生丰富的中间产物（如动作-观察轨迹），但这些产物在单次使用后通常被丢弃，或仅被生产者私有保留。现有方案（如RAG、思维重用、迁移学习、知识蒸馏、集中式多智能体协调）要么依赖人类撰写文档，要么要求源/目标域对齐与额外训练，要么假设合作性协议，难以适配开放、异构、可自由加入的智能体生态。论文借鉴人类群体中"交互记忆"（transactive memory）的概念，主张建立群体级基础设施以支持异构智能体间的知识共享。

Method: 1. **群体级存储库**：由生产者智能体贡献成功轨迹，消费者智能体检索使用，角色可重叠；2. **状态条件键值索引**：以近期l步交互历史为键（经共享嵌入函数f编码任务描述与轨迹片段），随后l步为值文档；3. **学习排序轨迹（LTRT）**：级联式检索管线（稠密检索→重排），六类共44个特征（生产者元数据含基准分数、消费者元数据、首阶段检索分数、查询特征、轨迹特征、查询-轨迹交互特征），按"边际效用"（注入检索后得分减去无检索基线）打标，训练FFN、LambdaMART、SVMRank三种重排器；4. **两阶段语料构建**：预填充（公开轨迹）→增量更新（roll-in到分支点、按选定位次roll-out生成标注、成功轨迹回写索引）；5. **选择性检索**：每步由RetrievalPlanner LLM判断是否调用检索。评估使用成功率（SR）、步数与Return-Paired Preference（RPP）。

Result: 在ALFWorld（274测试任务）与WebArena（88测试任务）上，使用35–37个异构LLM作为生产者、34个作为消费者：1. **无检索基线** ALFWorld SR 47.1%，WebArena SR 18.2%；**单阶段检索**分别提升至55.1%与20.5%，且步数下降；2. **重排器** 进一步增益——ALFWorld上SVMRank达SR 64.3%、步数10.35、RPP 0.15（最优），WebArena上FFN匹配最佳SR 20.5%并取得最低步数19.91；3. **跨能力分布**：检索收益与生产者-消费者能力差距相关性小且不显著（r=0.04–0.09），表明收益并非来自强→弱的单向传递；4. **跨任务泛化**：限制为同任务类型检索反而降低性能，跨任务检索SR仍远超无检索基线；5. **规模效应**：随索引规模扩大，ALFWorld呈单调增益，WebArena步数单调下降，SR在满量时反弹至20.9%；6. **特征重要性**：ALFWorld高度依赖生产者基准分数（SciCode、AAI、HLE等），WebArena特征重要性更分散。

Conclusion: MATM验证了"交互记忆"作为群体级智能体记忆架构的可行性：通过共享轨迹仓库与学习排序重排，异构智能体可在无协调、无联合训练的前提下复用彼此的程序性知识，跨能力等级、跨任务类型、跨记忆规模均产生一致的效能与效率增益。论文将MATM定位为开放智能体生态中群体级经验共享与持续集体智能的设计模式。未来方向包括：消费者侧个性化检索策略、生产者侧福利评估（双边市场）、对抗性生产者防护、跨基准重排器泛化以及更广泛的智能体-环境验证。

Abstract: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of agent-generated artifacts supporting a population of agents. In particular, agent trajectories encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet these artifacts are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent-generated trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution. We focus on interactive environments (ALFWorld and WebArena), where trajectories are long and encode especially rich procedural structure. Our experiments demonstrate that retrieving trajectories from MATM improves downstream task performance and reduces interaction steps without coordination or joint training. These results position MATM as a design pattern for population-level experience sharing in open agent ecosystems.

</details>


### [287] [eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19921)
*Shengbiao Lu,Xiaodong Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于元素的卷积神经网络（eCNNTO）来加速基于密度的拓扑优化（TO）。通过采用带残差连接的CNN来捕获相邻元素之间的空间相关性，并引入使用最终阶段密度历史作为训练数据的新策略，eCNNTO能在仅使用少量训练数据的情况下，泛化到不同的边界条件、载荷工况、设计域几何形状、网格分辨率及非设计域，在2D和3D问题中分别可减少高达90%和97%的SIMP迭代次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于SIMP的密度法拓扑优化需要大量迭代和有限元分析，在高分辨率密集网格下计算成本极高。现有的基于神经网络的加速方法存在两大缺陷：全局方法（如GAN、cGAN、encoder-decoder CNN）需要大量训练数据且泛化能力差；局部方法（如DLTOP使用Deep Belief Network逐元素预测）忽略了相邻元素的空间相关性，导致预测结构出现孤立部件和角接触等缺陷。因此需要一种兼具小数据需求和强泛化能力、并能保持结构连通性的加速方法。

Method: eCNNTO的核心方法包含三个方面：（1）网络架构：采用基于ResNet的CNN，输入为以目标元素为中心的H×W元素块（2D取W=5，3D取W=3）在前N次SIMP迭代中的密度序列（N×H×W张量），通过6个残差块（卷积+BN+ReLU组成）的卷积特征提取器（CFE）捕获空间相关性，再通过3层全连接分类头（FCCH）将密度预测视为3类或12类分类问题，使用交叉熵损失训练；（2）数据集构建：仅基于少量简单基准问题（2D悬臂梁和简支梁，3D悬臂梁）运行SIMP即可生成充足样本（2D约53200个，3D约50万个），边界元素用-1填充；（3）创新训练策略：不同于DLTOP使用早期阶段（Early Stage）密度序列作为输入特征，eCNNTO采用最终阶段（Final Stage）密度序列进行训练，因为早期数据噪声大，最终阶段数据更能反映收敛行为，从而提升加速效果并减少所需训练数据（仅为DLTOP的11.1%）。推理时仍使用前N次SIMP迭代作为输入，经eCNNTO预测近最优结构后再用少量SIMP迭代微调至收敛。

Result: 在分类粒度比较中，3类方案在分布外（OOD）样本上泛化能力更佳，被选为默认设置。在与DLTOP对比中，eCNNTO有效消除了DLTOP预测结构中的孤立部件、角接触和中间密度缺陷等问题，训练数据量仅为DLTOP的11.1%。在2D五个测试问题（长梁、方板、柱、L形支架、均布载荷梁）中，eCNNTO减少75.8%~90.5%的迭代次数，运行时间减少76.0%~91.7%，且合规度（compliance）通常更低。在3D四个测试问题中，减少76.0%~96.8%的迭代次数，运行时间减少78.2%~95.0%。窗口尺寸分析表明，2D中W=5为最佳平衡点（过大增加显存和时间而收益微小），3D中W=3为最佳选择。在含非设计域（圆形孔洞和桥面板）的测试中，eCNNTO严格遵守非设计约束，加速比分别达79.7%和89.0%，且合规度更优。

Conclusion: eCNNTO通过将CNN的空间相关性建模能力与最终阶段训练策略相结合，在仅需极少训练数据的前提下，显著加速了SIMP拓扑优化并保持了结构连通性。该方法在2D和3D中分别最高可减少90%和97%的迭代次数，同时在未见过的边界条件、载荷工况、设计域几何、网格分辨率及非设计域问题上展现出强大的泛化能力。未来工作方向包括：推广至多物理场拓扑优化、采用图神经网络（GNN）以适配非结构化网格、以及在学习过程中显式引入体积约束以进一步减少微调迭代次数。

Abstract: This work proposes an element-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accelerate density-based Topology Optimization (TO), termed eCNNTO. TO generally undergoes a large number of iterations, where finite element analysis is performed in every iteration, leading to the efficiency bottleneck especially when dense meshes are used to achieve high-resolution designs. To address this limitation, eCNNTO is proposed to build upon Kallioras et al. (2020), where a Deep Belief Network (DBN) was trained for every element to predict its near-optimal density from its early history, thereby skipping the great majority of iterations and significantly accelerating the TO procedure. However, the method lacks spatial correlations among neighboring elements and may lead to disconnected features in the final structure. The proposed method employs CNN with residual connections to address this issue. On top of it, a novel training strategy is introduced to further enhance the optimization efficiency, where the training dataset consists of the final stage density histories rather than early ones. This change can also help reduce the required training data size. eCNNTO requires only a small dataset to train and yet it can be generalized to problems with largely different boundary conditions, loading cases, design domain geometries, mesh resolutions, as well as non-design domains. In the end, the generalization capabilities and efficiency of eCNNTO are demonstrated through a variety of examples in two and three dimensions, achieving up to 90% and 97% reduction of iterations, respectively.

</details>


### [288] [The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19924)
*Aritra Sarkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了"自目的性AI"（Autotelic AI），即能够自主生成而非由设计者指定目标的智能体。作者系统地追溯了内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态调节和嵌入式主体性等概念，发现嵌入式性是自目的性主体的必要但不充分条件。论文的核心论点是：自目的性AI最深层的问题不是智能体如何生成目标，而是如何生成并相对化"自我"这一概念——智能体必须相信自身边界以采取行动，同时看透这一边界以理解世界。最终，作者提出了一个统一的框架 (π, 𝒢, μ, 𝒞α, V, b, M)，并将其拓展到量子力学形式化、哲学解读（与东方不二论传统对话）以及基于LLM的智能体实例化三个方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AI范式（监督学习、强化学习、游戏系统）建立在目标由设计者外生给定的假设之上。随着任务变得开放（如非结构化环境中的机器人操控、自主科学发现），手工设计的奖励变得脆弱、稀疏或具有误导性（奖励误规范问题）。任何追求人类水平智能或通用人工智能的系统最终都必须解决自目的性问题，因为人类显然具备这种能力。该论文的动机是探索当智能体开始自主生成目标时会发生什么，并深入解决这一根本性的开放问题。

Method: 论文采用理论分析与概念综合的方法：(1) 形式化自目的性智能体为元组 (π, 𝒢, μ)，其中 𝒢 是目标空间，μ 是目标上的内生分布；(2) 依次审视内在动机（惊奇、新颖性、信息增益、学习进度、赋能、自由能等）的局限性；(3) 引入基于算法信息论的资源驱动先验（LEAST分类法：长度、能量、逼近、空间、时间），结合Levin复杂度、Bennett逻辑深度等；(4) 通过do-calculus和算法信息动力学探讨因果干预；(5) 引入稳态调节和Markov毯作为嵌入式主体的形式化框架；(6) 借助自由能原理和二阶控制论处理观察者-系统问题；(7) 将框架拓展到量子域（CPTP映射、Lindbladian表示）、哲学层面（与不二论传统对话）和LLM智能体实现（带可接受性过滤器的随机状态机）。

Result: 论文得出以下关键结果：(1) 内在动机虽然有效，但并未真正回答自目的性问题——它用一个内生标量 r_int 替代了外生标量 r，但目标空间 𝒢 仍然隐式且单一；(2) 资源驱动先验提供 μ 但缺乏终极辩护——任何先验都通过表征选择隐含了实质性承诺；(3) 因果干预提供 𝒢 作为可控因素，但留下 μ 不确定；(4) 稳态调节（维持存活集 V）提供了一个自我辩护的不动点，但预设了一个嵌入式智能体；(5) 嵌入式性是必要的（没有 V、b 就无法行动），但不充分——同一动力学 F 允许多种有效的Markov毯划分，每种划分定义不同的候选"自我"；(6) 核心悖论：智能体必须相信自身边界以行动，但必须看透该边界以理解世界——这是"操作上不可或缺、本体上虚幻"的虚构；(7) 提出了量子化拓展路径（QKSQA、EQKSQA、EQKSQAA等里程碑）和基于LLM的工程实例化方案，包括四个评估维度：连续性一致性、边界维护、目标涌现多样性、自我修复能力。

Conclusion: 本文得出结论：自目的性问题的答案不在于任何单一组件，而在于 V、b、M 的联合运作。智能体行动是因为有 V 需要捍卫，V 之所以良定义是因为有 b 限定它，b 在 M 中被视为根本（只要行动需要），同时在 M 中被相对化（只要探究允许）。论文将这一悖论定位为核心洞见而非需要修复的缺陷：它超越了"纯粹主体性"（脱离世界的智能体）与"纯粹物理学"（如同无观察者存在般描述世界）的虚假二元对立。论文标题"The Tao of Agency"刻意呼应Capra的"Tao of Physics"，指出智能体-环境、目标-自我的二元划分在操作上不可或缺但在本体论上是虚幻的。

Abstract: Most artificial intelligence systems are built on the assumption that goals are exogenous and specified by the designer. Exploring what happens when an agent begins generating its own goals opens the field of autotelic AI. Agents are expected not merely to pursue objectives but to discover them. In this article, we trace its consequences through intrinsic motivation, resource-driven priors, causal-interventional learning, homeostasis, and embeddedness; the last of which is found to be a necessary but not sufficient condition for autotelic agency. Embeddedness individuates the agent at the cost of revealing that the individuation is non-unique, such that the same dynamics admit many valid partitions, each defining a different candidate self. The deepest problem with autotelic AI is therefore not how the agent generates goals, but how it generates and relativizes the self to which the goals are assigned. The agent must believe in its own boundary in order to act, and see through that boundary in order to understand. We consolidate these developments into a single framework and extend it along three directions: a quantum formulation in which the agent-environment cut becomes physical, a philosophical reading against non-dual contemplative traditions, and a concrete LLM-based agentic instantiation.

</details>


### [289] [PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19935)
*Zhangzhao Liang,Xiaofen Xing,Mingyue Yang,Wenlve Zhou,Xiangmin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhysDrift 提出了一种面向仿人机器人的"具身感知（embodiment-aware）"语音驱动协同动作生成框架,通过 IK-EER 机器人原生数据构建框架与 Motion Drift Field (MDF) 生成模型,直接在机器人关节空间中学习并生成可执行的协同动作,消除了传统"以人为中心"(SMPL-X 生成 + 重定向)流水线中存在的具身鸿沟(embodiment gap)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同动作生成流水线大多以人为中心:先在 SMPL-X 等人体表征中生成动作,再通过逆向运动学重定向到仿人机器人。但人体运动流形 M_h 与机器人可执行运动流形 M_r 之间存在本质不匹配,导致重定向过程压缩了动作多样性、削弱了韵律-动作同步性,限制了仿人机器人在自然交互中的表达力。本文系统地形式化这一"具身鸿沟",并主张直接在机器人原生动作空间中进行生成。

Method: 1) IK-EER 数据构建框架:在 BEAT2 基础上,通过 IK 初始化 + 能量包络(EE)对齐(基于 NCC 的语音-动作能量互相关)+ 物理正则(关节限位、足部接触、滑步抑制),联合优化运动学可行性与语音-动作时序一致性,得到机器人原生动作数据集。2) PhysDrift 生成模型:提出 Motion Drift Field (MDF),将生成视为流形吸引问题而非速度场传输问题(避免切空间累积误差),直接预测样本到目标流形的位移 D(x)≈x*−x;采用 6D 根朝向+关节角+根位置的机器人原生表征,设计结构化距离(测地距离/周期距离/L2);训练损失包含 L_drift + 关节限位损失 + EE 损失;支持单步(one-step)推理。3) 在 Unitree-G1 平台上完成真机部署。

Result: 1) 重定向会显著降低动作多样性(如 GT 从 12.76 降至 7.319)并削弱语音-动作对齐,验证了具身鸿沟的存在。2) IK-EER 相比 GMR/Mink/PHC 等基线,在保持物理可行性的同时将对齐分数从 0.55 提升至 0.69。3) 机器人原生表征(6D 根+关节角)相比 SMPL-X+VQVAE 显著降低 FMD(从 4.18 降至 0.62)。4) PhysDrift 在 FMD(0.546)、对齐(0.686)、多样性(12.20)、jerk(118.0)、关节违规(无)、推理速度(2880 APS)之间取得最佳平衡;而无约束 Flow Matching(如 ShortcutFlow)虽多样性极高(29.41),但 jerk 达 975.4,无法在真机上稳定执行。5) 在 G1 真机上完成实时语音交互验证。

Conclusion: 仿人机器人协同动作生成的主要瓶颈不在于运动学可行性,而在于人体中心表征与机器人具身约束之间的不一致。本文提出的 IK-EER + PhysDrift 框架通过在机器人原生动作空间中直接建模并引入具身感知物理正则,在表达力、物理合理性、语音对齐、推理效率与实时交互能力上均优于传统人中心流水线,为未来社交仿人机器人的具身一致生成提供了新方向。

Abstract: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.

</details>


### [290] [Advancing DialNav through Automatic Embodied Dialog Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19948)
*Leekyeung Han,Sangwon Jung,Hyunji Min,Jinseong Jeong,Minyoung Kim,Paul Hongsuck Seo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RAINbow数据集和双重策略训练方法，显著提升了DialNav任务中具身智能体的对话导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DialNav任务中，具身导航智能体需要与远程引导员进行多轮对话以解决初始指令的模糊性。然而，该任务的训练数据极其稀缺（仅2K回合），且人工标注成本高昂（约3.75美元/回合），严重制约了模型性能。本文旨在通过自动数据生成管道和训练策略改进，解决DialNav的数据稀缺问题。

Method: 1. **RAINbow数据集生成管道**：(a) 轨迹拼接——将R2R、RxR、CVDN等VLN数据集的2-4条路径拼接为长轨迹；(b) 在对话点用LLaVA-1.5-7B生成全景场景描述作为问题内容，复用原始VLN细粒度指令作为答案；(c) 使用GPT-4o-mini将原始描述-指令对重写为自然多轮对话。  
2. **双重策略训练（DST）**：结合数据引导回放（沿标注路径导航并接收真实对话更新）和在线策略回放（在对话点分叉后按自身策略执行，以最短路径为监督），解决训练-测试不匹配和错误恢复问题。  
3. **基于图Transformer的定位模型（GTL）**：复用DUET架构，将导航指令替换为Navigator问题，输入为完整环境图，通过VLN预训练权重迁移实现定位。

Result: 在RAIN验证集上，最终模型在Val Seen的SR从30.77提升至58.24（+89%），Val Unseen的SR从14.52提升至29.05（+100%），刷新SOTA。RAINbow包含238K回合（比RAIN大两个数量级），生成成本约0.0016美元/回合（比人工标注便宜约2000倍）。消融实验表明三个组件高度协同：RAINbow单独使用提升有限，但与DST结合后效果显著放大；GTL进一步提升定位精度。在WAY定位任务和CVDN数据集上也展现出良好的泛化性能。人机协作实验中，Guide角色的人类评分从2.10提升至2.52。

Conclusion: 本文通过自动数据生成（RAINbow）、双重策略训练和基于VLN知识的定位模型三大创新，有效解决了DialNav任务的数据稀缺和训练不匹配问题，将成功率翻倍。三个组件高度互补，验证了大规模合成数据与匹配训练策略对具身对话导航的重要性，为未来更复杂的交互式具身智能体研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: For embodied agents capable of physical interaction, the capability to create and understand dialog is crucial to ensure both safety and effectiveness. While DialNav~\cite{han2025dialnav} provides a framework for holistic evaluation of the dialog--execution loop in photorealistic indoor navigation, its performance remains limited by a critical scarcity of training data (2K episodes). To address this, we propose an automatic generation pipeline, and construct the \textbf{RAINbow} dataset, a large-scale training dataset with 238K episodes for DialNav. Our pipeline converts existing VLN datasets into multi-turn dialog and creates cost-efficient and high-quality dataset. Then, we introduce two additional complementary advances to unlock the data's full potential: (1) Dual-Strategy Training, a navigation training scheme to align the navigation training with the dynamic dialog-navigation loop, and (2) a localization model that leverages VLN knowledge. By combining these complementary solutions, our model substantially outperforms the baseline in success rate on both \textbf{Val Seen} (58.24, \textbf{+89\%}) and \textbf{Val Unseen} (29.05, \textbf{+100\%}) splits, establishing a new state of the art.

</details>


### [291] [ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19980)
*Wenli Xiao,Jia Xie,Tonghe Zhang,Haotian Lin,Letian "Max" Fu,Haoru Xue,Jalen Lu,Yi Yang,Cunxi Dai,Zi Wang,Jimmy Wu,Guanzhi Wang,S. Shankar Sastry,Ken Goldberg,Linxi "Jim" Fan,Yuke Zhu,Guanya Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ENPIRE 是一个面向真实机器人的"物理自研"框架,通过将真实世界反馈(自动重置、验证、回滚)封装为 Gym 风格 API,让前沿编码 Agent(Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code)能够在无人在环的情况下自动搜索并优化灵巧操作策略,在 8 台 YAM 双臂机器人组成的机队上实现了 99% 的成功率(销钉插入、扎带切割、GPU 插入、Push-T 等任务),并随机队规模扩展显著加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前真实世界灵巧操作策略学习高度依赖人工监督(数据采集、重置、奖励设计、算法调参),成为迈向通用物理智能的瓶颈。已有编码 Agent 虽能自动化算法搜索,但其闭环验证仍局限在数字环境(仿真、代码执行),缺乏在真实物理硬件上进行可重复"假设—执行—验证—迭代"回路的抽象。需要一套把机器人反馈循环自动化的框架,让 Agent 真正"在物理世界里做研究"。

Method: 框架分两阶段:**Stage 1(EN)**——Agent 通过过程式工具调用(基于 SAM3 分割、BundleSDF 位姿估计、cuRobo 运动规划、力控夹爪等)合成自动重置、自动验证(混合视觉+本体感觉+力的奖励函数)与硬安全约束,封装为不可变的 Gym API(一次性人工评估,后续复用)。**Stage 2(PIRE)**——Agent 在该 API 上自主改进策略(PI),支持启发式学习、行为克隆(BC)、离线和在线 RL;**Rollout(R)** 在真实机器人上并行评估;**Evolution(E)** 通过 Git 实现多 Agent 异步去中心化协作——各 Agent 独立创建分支,自发 cherry-pick、合并同伴的改进,形成"想法树"并对策略成功率进行 hill-climb。论文还提出两项资源利用指标:**MRU**(机器人活跃时间占比)与 **MTU**(每分钟 token 消耗),用于度量多智能体物理自研效率。系统建立在 8 站 YAM 双臂机器人机队之上,采用 PLD-RL/SERL 风格的三层分布式部署(部署/学习/推理),力控夹爪、PD+重力补偿,30Hz 策略推理,100Hz 底层控制。
